listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Ludatrix Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: The Vyrao Ludatrix Eau de Parfum (10ml) is a daring and empowering fragrance that fuses notes of lipstick and latex with soft rose, Sichuan pepper and inspiring orris. Tantalising ambrette ignites arousal, layered with voluptuous cedarwood, sandalwood and olibanum to evoke positivity and protection. A potent blend of ambrox and musk deepens the sensuality, making this scent both bold and irresistible. Designed to evoke bold desire and fearless self-expression, it's a provocative yet sophisticated fragrance that captures boundless confidence and allure in every spray.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 85ml
listings.description: Are you a fan of floral fragrances? Enter: Hermès' Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum (85ml), which is just that but with a twist. Opening with a bright zesty spark, this fragrance stars ginger, bitter orange and bergamot top notes. It then blooms into a flowering heart of tuberose, orange blossom and jasmine to add a fresh-sweet touch. Finally, it mingles on a comforting bed of creamy sandalwood and vanilla. The cherry on top? It's housed in a lantern-shaped bottle finished with a hand-tied silk ribbon that makes for a playful aesthetic to this ensemble.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Rose Morning Eau de Parfum 9ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to a garden in full bloom at dawn with the Rose Morning Eau de Parfum (9ml) from fresh. Like a bouquet of fresh-cut roses, this perfume takes you on an olfactive journey. Opening with notes of rose, blackcurrant and violet leaf, it has a very fresh introduction. Then, it blooms into a heart of Bulgarian rose, peach blossom and freesia which gives a fruity, powdery and somewhat spicy feel to the scent. As for the base? It's sweetened with tones of white tea, amber and musk for a comforting touch. We almost think it's better than receiving a bunch of roses...

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Cash Flower Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Looking to expand your fragrance wardrobe? Fugazzi's Cash Flower (50ml) will send senses swimming with notes of alluring rose, soft cashmere and warming amber. Created using petals from roses that have been harvested in the early morning when their scent is most potent (and before the sun and heat worsen the scents quality), this eau de parfum is a floral delight. After opening with notes of sweet roses, this fragrance boasts undertones of cashmere that adds a velvety softness. Then, notes of vibrant pepper and warm amber pack a punch to make it stand out. To finish? The mystery of musk and sandalwood will leave you wanting more. So, get ready to spritz to your hearts content.

listings.rawTitle: Liis Discovery Set 5 x 2ml
listings.description: Discover a new favourite fragrance with Liis' Discovery Set, featuring five trial-sized scents. First up, there's Rose Struck; a fresh combination of cassis and matcha tea intertwined with of rose centifolia, then Bo boasts a smoky bed of white cedar, incense and vanilla beans. As for Studied? This soothing scent welcomes notes of ambrette, pear and ambroxan, while Floating transports you a lazy morning with a blend of bergamot, wild orchid and crisp linen. And the grand finale? Lucienne, an uplifting scent that features accords of magnolia, dragon fruit and marine accord. We reckon you're going to love them all. Contents: Rose Struck Eau de Parfum (2ml)< /p> Bo Eau de Parfum (2ml)< /p> Studied Eau de Parfum (2ml)< /p> Floating Eau de Parfum (2ml)< /p> Lucienne Eau de Parfum (2ml)< /p>

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Embrace the radiance of sunny days with Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) a luminous, fruity musk that captures the joy and freshness of summer. This crisp, lightweight fragrance opens with a bright pear accord, evoking childhood memories and the promise of warm, carefree days. Centred around the iconic cetalox note (famous from Not a Perfume) it offers a clean, modern musk that gently lingers. Completed by subtle hints of ambroxan and musks, it’s a refreshing, slightly gourmand scent that radiates positivity and happiness. Packaged in a striking teal ombre bottle, it’s perfect for uplifting your mood or gifting to someone special. Effortlessly sophisticated, this fragrance is a joyful ode to sunshine and good vibes.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Sacred Wood 50ml
listings.description: Hiding within the alluring depths of this black-lacquered bottle is a captivating ode to sandalwood. Part of the woodsy Cellar family of fragrances, Sacred Wood highlights the all-encompassing intensity of this lusted-after scent with spicy aromas that excite and entice the wearer and all who cross their path. Opening with a spicy, earthy blend of ambrette and carrot seed essence, the coveted sandalwood accord is then revealed to the wearer - sourced from Mysore for its uniquely woodsy, milky facets - then blended with Moroccan cedarwood oil atlas and amyris oil. As this heady, woody aroma settles, a warming air of Copaiba balsam oil unfolds to reach the crescendo of this sacred scent with a malted, incense-like aroma that is exceptionally long-lasting.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress and Grapevine Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Meet your new olfactory obsession, Jo Malone London's Cypress and Grapevine Cologne Intense (50ml). Think: aromatic, distinctive and bold. Imagine you could bottle the fragrant aroma of a verdant hanging garden, enhanced with statuesque cypress trees and intertwining grapevines. Well, Jo Malone London has with this exquisite cologne. It opens with resinous, woody notes, before revealing a sensual heart with warming hints of amber and juicy grapes. The base brings up back to earth with grounding moss. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Black Saffron Absolu de Parfum Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Experience the allure of Byredo's Black Saffron Absolu de Parfum Eau de Parfum (100ml) a richer, more intense take on the signature scent. Opening with vibrant nutmeg and juicy blackcurrant, it introduces a bright, dynamic freshness that softens into a lush floral heart. The base notes of black leather, incense, patchouli and agarwood create a bold, deep foundation, offering an opulent, addictive expression of Black Saffron's enduring legacy. Housed in a redesigned bottle inspired by craftsmanship, the textured cap, influenced by Yakisugi (the Japanese art of charring wood), opens to reveal a silver and gold atomizer. This elemental design reflects the fragrance's deep intensity and transformation.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: TOM FORD Oud Wood Eau de Parfum Spray (10ml) ignites with a slow, smouldering warmth laced with intrigue. At its core, rare oud wood is wrapped in the heat of cardamom and exotic spices, while sandalwood and rosewood add smooth depth. Presented in the brand’s smoked grey bottle, it’s part of TOM FORD’s Private Blend collection, a fragrance that leaves an impression long after you’ve left the room.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance - Cobalt Patchouli and Cedar 100ml
listings.description: Bottling the spirit of optimism that everyone is clinging to as we make strides towards a more liberated life, Jo Loves' A Fragrance - Cobalt Patchouli and Cedar has a care-free cocktail of grapefruit, patchouli, cedarwood and geranium notes. A wisp of fresh air with an eclectic twist, this vegan and cruelty-free fragrance has a bright yet sultry profile that clings to your skin like a summer breeze. Deviating from Jo Loves' classic red bottle, this unique perfume has a blue colour story that speaks of the clean, crisp air that inspires the hopeful scent. It’s available in two sizes – 50ml and 100ml – so you can ensure you’re never without your signature scent – keep one in your bag, one on your desk or in pride of place on your dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Oudgasm Cafe Oud 19 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: KAYALI's Oudgasm Cafe Oud 19 (50ml) combines creamy cappuccino notes, fresh florals and (of course) the woody wonder of oud. A warm and spicy scent, it's a celebration of one of perfume's most precious and beloved ingredients (read: oud). Refreshing top notes of bergamot, mandarin and cappuccino meld delicately with a heady centre of geranium and rose damascena, which gives way to a spicy-but-sweet bouquet of Madagascan vanilla, white musk, patchouli and oud. Its rich woodiness lends this luxurious aroma an intensity that balances beautifully with the familiar warmth of vanilla. The verdict? It's a sweet scent sation...

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Sugar Lemon Eau de Parfum 9ml
listings.description: The Sugar Lemon Eau de Parfum (9ml) from fresh is like a refreshing, sparkling drink on a warm summer's day. Bursting with bright accords to envelop your senses, this fragrance opens with citrus notes of lemon and yuzu before it cascades into a heart of lychee, ginger and African orange flower for an uplifting feeling. As for the base? It features tones of caramel, oak moss and sandalwood to add a warming, comforting feel to this fresh perfume. It's a true treat for all.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Bergamote 22 - Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: After a sweet scent sation? Add the Bergamote 22 Eau de Parfum (50ml) to your growing collection of Le Labo icons. Opening with a dazzling burst of tart grapefruit and bergamot, this signature fragrance unfolds with light floral notes, which deepen further as the day goes on. From delicate accords of petit grain and heady amber to an anchored blend of vetiver and musk, this warm yet vibrant scent lingers seductively on the skin. Boasting an alluring fusion of aromas down to the last drop, prepare to savour every spritz of this must-have perfume that'll have everyone asking what you're wearing. Go on, tell them...

listings.rawTitle: Creed Delphinus 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by a constellation that resembles a dolphin, The House of Creed's Delphinus is a fragrance that represents the beautiful mystery amongst the stars. Opening with a powdery top note of iris, this scent binds together earthy, woody and floral accords reminiscent of a violet flower. It then bursts into a heart of spicy incense which adds a dark and rich feel to the aroma. Finally, taking centre stage a touch of leathery bourbon vanilla brings it all together to create the feeling of gazing under a sky full of sparkling stars. It will no doubt leave a memorable impression on whoever passes you by...

listings.rawTitle: Creed Delphinus 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by a constellation that resembles a dolphin, The House of Creed's Delphinus is a fragrance that represents the beautiful mystery amongst the stars. Opening with a powdery top note of iris, this scent binds together earthy, woody and floral accords reminiscent of a violet flower. It then bursts into a heart of spicy incense which adds a dark and rich feel to the aroma. Finally, taking centre stage a touch of leathery bourbon vanilla brings it all together to create the feeling of gazing under a sky full of sparkling stars. It will no doubt leave a memorable impression on whoever passes you by...

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Scent Layering Set (Worth £42.00)
listings.description: Starring a trio of formulas in the bestselling spring-inspired scent, the Molton Brown Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Scent Layering Set uplifts the senses in this fruity-floral collection. Beginning in the bath (or shower), this set gently cleanses, moisturises and fragrances with its signature lychee, peony, raspberry and cedarwood blend, leaving you smelling delectable and feeling fresh for longer. Contents: Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Bath & Shower Gel (100ml) Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Body Lotion (100ml)

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON La Petite Bougie Cire 70g
listings.description: Paying homage to the process of candle-making, this petite size (30g) scented candle emanates warmth — from the pretty amber glass to the notes of bergamot and honey that feel like a hug. At the heart of this legendary establishment is bees and beeswax: Trudon’s motto is even “they (the bees) work for God and the King”. Here this love for the honey-bestowing creatures is embodied in the absolute beeswax of the candle. Light this sensation and take in the top notes of bergamot, honey and waxed wood that settle into notes of beeswax absolute, sandalwood and cinnamon. Doesn’t that sound like a warm winter’s day condensed into one very chic gold-embossed candle? What’s more, tonka beans and patchouli ground this unique scent for a truly relaxing, sensorial experience.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao The Sixth Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tap into your sixth sense with this beautifully light and uplifting fragrance from Vyrao. The packaging includes the affirmation: 'I connect to the source of life, light, love and abundance' - designed to bring you into a state of calm and mindfulness. Vyrao has infused a multitude of sacred herbs into this empowering fragrance, which have been selected for their positive effects on the mind and body - in other words, this scent marries olfactory magic with wellbeing. Top notes of angelica root and juniper berry envelope a calming green heart of apple, fennel and peppermint, layered over grounding base notes of cedarwood, patchouli and oakwood. Expect to feel calmer, more balanced in your nervous system and rid of negative feelings that might be holding you back. Oh, and don't miss the supercharged Herkimer diamond sitting pretty within the bottle - it's been energised by the brand's healer, Louise Mita. Good vibrations, incoming.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Impadia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Evening skies brushed in amber and gold, silhouettes traced in violet shadows, trailing blooms dotted with crimson — Impadia Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a painterly portrait of Paris, a love letter to its expressive heart. Top notes of sparkling mandarin, bergamot and ginger evoke the first light of dawn and final flickers of twilight. A romantic heart of rose and orange flowers leads into a base of creamy vanilla, praline and musk, enhancing depth and warmth. Pulled into its magnetic orbit, the city’s most creative spirits find their muse in Paris — painters, poets, ballerinas, bohemians and composers. Impadia is a tribute to this legacy: a living canvas of colour, expression and creative abandon.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Lychee Rose Travel Spray 8 mL/.27 fl oz.
listings.description: Step into a summer garden party with the NEST New York Lychee Rose Eau de Parfum (8ml), a sparkling scent with notes of pink champagne. Compliments, incoming... Enchant and enthral with this delectable scent, featuring a vibrant combination of rose absolute and fresh lychee. Elsewhere in this fragrance dream team, bubbling pink champagne and a hint of raspberry come together to create an effervescent aroma. Whether you use it alone or layer with other NEST New York scents (sold separately), simply spray onto your wrists and inhale for a moment of sheer joy.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Golden Nectar Eau De Parfum 50 mL/1.7 fl oz.
listings.description: Transport yourself back in time with the NEST New York Golden Nectar Eau de Parfum (50ml). This scent is inspired by the tale of Cleopatra dipping her ship sails in perfume to lightly scent the wind before her arrival on shore. A floral, gourmand fragrance, it effortlessly combines notes of golden orchid and sueded amber with creamy vanilla and musk, resulting in a sensual blend that immerses the senses in a cloud of opulence. No matter the occasion, this perfume is the equivalent of hard-won treasure that will earn you compliments wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under the Stars Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Fancy a night in the wild? Look to Maison Margiela's Under the Stars Eau de Toilette (100ml) to transport you to a mystical place. Opening with accords of oud essence, this scent then deepens into labdanum (a flowering plant), which offers sweet, amber notes that conjures the warmth of summer wind caressing the skin. Plus, it stars hints of rich and wild leather with spicy black pepper that captivates the experience of immersing oneself in nature. It's a unique olfactive creation that leaves an unforgettable impression on everyone you pass by.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian GENTLE FLUIDITY GOLD Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Two distinctive scents, one selection of notes, the Maison Francis Kurkdijan Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum (70ml) is held within a gilded, glowing flacon. The Gentle Fluidity poses the challenge of creating two different fragrances, with the same selection of notes. Gold focuses on a gourmand profile with an extra dose of crisp musks and rich vanilla. Coriander seeds compliment musks breezy quality, while amber wood builds on vanilla's scent-sual takeover.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Matcha 45 EDP 10ml
listings.description: Frothy, milky bubbles of matcha, expertly whisked, set the scene for KAYALI Freedom Musk Matcha 45 (10ml). The scent opens with crisp matcha and bright bergamot, unfolding into a creamy heart of oat milk and praline. A gentle trail of sandalwood and sweet musk lingers, wrapping the skin in long lasting warmth. Lightweight and easy to layer, this EDP slips into your bag or desk drawer for a quick, sweet spritz wherever you are.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml Perfume Spray
listings.description: Taking the fresh, floral and alluring scent of the original Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum, the Extreme edition encapsulates a summer spent surrounded by beautiful flowers, but with a luxurious, milky twist. Beginning with beguiling notes of apricot-tinged osmanthus absolute, orange blossom and rose of May absolute, the subtle scent is paired with a charming bouquet of syrupy tuberose, jasmine and narcissus, draped in a milky toffy elixir. The result is a subtle, comforting, creamy scent that works as the perfect accessory for every outfit, occasion or season. Smooth and reassuring, this is a far cry from your average floral fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: If you like the rich and woody scent of oud, the Royal Oud Eau de Parfum is quickly going to become your new scent staple. If you're going for a deep and dark vibe, we suggest you spritz this, stat. Smoky frankincense, wood accord and of course, oud combine to create the base notes of this sensual fragrance, while an uplifting blend of lime, galbanum and bergamot top the scent. As for the heart? Cardamon and clove lend their spicy, warming fragrance, delivering a show-stopping woody scent... but with a difference. We're snapping it up immediately...

listings.rawTitle: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: If you like the rich and woody scent of oud, the Royal Oud Eau de Parfum is quickly going to become your new scent staple. If you're going for a deep and dark vibe, we suggest you spritz this, stat. Smoky frankincense, wood accord and of course, oud combine to create the base notes of this sensual fragrance, while an uplifting blend of lime, galbanum and bergamot top the scent. As for the heart? Cardamon and clove lend their spicy, warming fragrance, delivering a show-stopping woody scent... but with a difference. We're snapping it up immediately...

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Verbena Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Bright and uplifting, Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Verbena Eau de Parfum (150ml) distils the citrusy freshness of verbena leaves. Nuances of bergamot and cedrat bring a citrusy lift, while verbena absolute mingles with rosemary and peppermint for a green, aromatic heart. A soft base of cedarwood, musk and bitter almond leaves a subtle trace on the skin. Wear it alone for a refreshing citrus hit or layer with other Atelier des Fleurs scents to build your own olfactory bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao High Five Volume 2 Set
listings.description: Elevate your mood and your scent game with the Vyrao High Five Volume 2 Set, a curated collection of five pioneering neuro-inspired fragrances designed to lift, shift and personalize your vibe. Each genderless eau de parfum harnesses neuroscience-backed ingredients to evoke distinct emotional states, from energising and uplifting to calming and grounding. Mix and layer these captivating scents to create a signature aroma that reflects your mood and style. With five beautifully crafted mini bottles; The Sixth, Sun Rae, Mamajuju, Ludeaux and Ludatrix; this set invites you to explore a layered, sensory journey that transforms your daily routine into a ritual of empowerment and self-expression. Contents: The Sixth Eau de Parfum (10ml) Sun Rae Eau de Parfum (10ml) Mamajuju Eau de Parfum (10ml) Ludeaux Eau de Parfum (10ml) Ludatrix Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by Chloé founder Gaby Aghion's birthplace, Nomade Lumière d'Égypte (50ml) evokes a journey along the Nile where blue lotus blooms. Blue lotus opens the scent, followed by soft jasmine, while pink berry and elemi add a richness and warmth. A base of kyphi accord with cinnamon, sandalwood and myrrh gives depth for a long-lasting olfactive trail. Encased in the Nomade bottle with golden accents and a dusky blue knot, the scent carries a light, aquatic floralcy.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Bergamote 22 - Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: After a sweet scent sation? Add the Bergamote 22 Eau de Parfum (100ml) to your growing collection of Le Labo icons. Opening with a dazzling burst of tart grapefruit and bergamot, this signature fragrance unfolds with light floral notes, which deepen further as the day goes on. From delicate accords of petit grain and heady amber to an anchored blend of vetiver and musk, this warm yet vibrant scent lingers seductively on the skin. Boasting an alluring fusion of aromas down to the last drop, prepare to savour every spritz of this must-have perfume that'll have everyone asking what you're wearing. Go on, tell them...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Restore Body Oil 150ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Restore Body Oil (200ml) offers a luxurious, sensorial experience, leaving skin feeling nourished, soft and radiant. Crafted with primrose and almond oils, it nourishes and enhances suppleness while absorbing quickly for a non-greasy finish. Infused with a calming white floral aroma of jasmine, neroli and rosehip essential oils, inspired by Roman decadence, it creates a soothing and indulgent scent. Designed for daily use, this body oil provides a silky, soft texture that effortlessly smooths and leaves limbs with a subtle sheen. Supported by neurosensorial research, it transforms your routine into a moment of replenishment and relaxation, leaving skin beautifully nourished, silky and beautifully scented.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense (100ml) transports you to the sun-drenched hills of Andalusia, where wild cistus and warm amber notes fill the air. The scent is enriched with bitter orange, labdanum, vanilla and roasted oak, creating a rich, sensual aroma that’s both powerful and evocative. The woody core is lifted by the sweetness of vanilla and the depth of roasted oak, leaving a luxurious trail with every wear. This intense fragrance beautifully captures the warmth and vitality of sunlit fields, offering a bold yet sophisticated sensory experience. Crafted with signature expertise and high-quality ingredients, this is a modern, versatile scent that’s easy to love and perfect for making a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Mamajuju Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Become grounded, connected and awakened with neuroscented mother earth stories by Vyrao Mamajuju Eau De Parfum (50ml). Smooth, balancing Australian sandalwood dances with an energetic blend of saffron, cumin, nutmeg, cardamom and pink pepper to speak to the soul and soothe the senses. Warming rum, earthy wet red clay and olibanum give this scent its deep rootedness and cocooning sense of comfort. These natural ingredients are passionately backed by neuroscience research and presented in a luxurious brown metallic bottle containing an energetically charged Herkimer diamond crystal for balance.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum 20ml
listings.description: Paying homage to the rose flower but with a vibrant twist, Acqua di Parma's Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum (20ml) is a scent you won't be able to resist. Opening with an invigorating citrus burst of bergamot and mandarin, it then leans into spicy tinges of fresh black pepper, pink pepper and cardamom oil. And that's all before we mention the Bulgarian rose oil (that's extracted through steam-water distillation to capture the essence of the flower), which blends floral, green, spicy accords with hints of honey. As for the base? You are met with vetiver, guaiac wood, and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum is bursting with sweet floral notes, just as its name suggests. This addictive scent boasts majestically blooming roses bathed in light, and paired with a juicy white peach over a deliciously woody base. The pretty pink bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity, and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Sugar Addict Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A symphony of sweet notes sprinkled with sophistication, BORNTOSTANDOUT's Sugar Addict Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an elevated take on all things decadent. Inspired by tempting treats, this candied perfume opens with an indulgent aroma of sugar and cinnamon essence, warmed by cocoa absolute and coffee extract. Nuanced yet nostalgic, its scent profile dries down with a creamy vanilla, tonka bean and cashmere wood finish, laced with a splash of rum for a luxuriously rich trail. Think sweet, free spirited and playful with a sensuous, multi-layered allure.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Indecent Cherry Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Cherry, but not as you know it. BORNTOSTANDOUT's Indecent Cherry Eau De Parfum (50ml) takes the fruit and flips it on its head. Sultry and unapologetic, it opens with a glossy cherry note that's equal parts juicy and mischievous, softened only slightly by whispers of almond and creamy vanilla. But just when you think you've figured it out, the scent deepens as amber, sandalwood and a hint of spice turn up the heat, revealing something a little darker. Audacious from first spritz, this is the cherry that bites back.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Layering Collection
listings.description: If you could bottle the heady scent of sun-warmed fruits and blooms dancing in the air, we imagined the English Pear & Sweet Pea Scent Layering Collection from Jo Malone London would be it. Uniting three of its bestselling scents, this curated collection crystallises the brand's esteem as masters of modern perfumery. Centred around the luminous, verdant scent of English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne, this set invites you to mix and match with fragrance: add a splash of citrus with Grapefruit, a frisson of freshness with English Oak & Hazelnut or a sultry flicker of warmth with English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne. It's scent alchemy, crafted by you. Contents: English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne (30ml) Grapefruit Cologne (9ml) English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne (9ml) Peony & Blush Suede Cologne (9ml)

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women 150ml
listings.description: Experience the richer facets of orange blossom in the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women (150ml) a warm, floral-amber scent. Opening with bright petit grain, bergamot and a hint of pink pepper, the scent flows into a heart of neroli and orange flower. Green mate, patchouli and soft vanilla form a subtle, lingering base. Housed in a midnight-blue pleated bottle with gold-toned accents, this floral Eau de Parfum can be layered or worn alone, leaving a refined, evening-ready trail.

listings.rawTitle: Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi La Riserva Eau de Parfum 100ml
Commodity Juice- Personal 100ml
listings.description: Embrace light, sweet notes in Commodity's Juice- Personal (100ml), a fragrance that's inspired by the light side of red berries. Perfect for those who want to savour their scent and hold it close, this light rendition blends accents of raspberry pulp, violet leaf and strawberry notes. Traces of Bulgarian rose and sugary cyclamen begin to pull through after a few minutes. As for the base? You are met with warming accords of rhubarb and amberwood. Delish!

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Duo
listings.description: Uplift the senses with the gift-wrapped Cypress & Grapevine Duo by Jo Malone London. Enhancing your fragrance rituals, this aromatic two-piece stars a full sized hand wash and cologne in the earthy-woody Cypress & Grapevine scent. Made with notes of fresh cypress tree, grapevine and warm amber, it leaves a lingering trail that lasts long into the night… CONTENTS: Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense (50ml) Cypress & Grapevine All Over Body Spray (125ml)

listings.rawTitle: The Nue Co. First Milk | Comfort Gourmand | Fragrance 50ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the warmth and comfort of pure nostalgia with The Nue Co. First Milk Fragrance (50ml) an indulgent scent that evokes the gentle embrace of early memories. Crafted with neuroscent technology, this fragrance interacts with your body's chemistry to create a soothing, familiarity-inducing experience. It weaves soft almond milk, tonka bean, iris and a hint of pink pepper into a cocoon of amber and cashmere woods, delivering a delicate yet comforting aura. Designed to ground and uplift, this is perfect for moments of self-care or as a heartfelt gift. Its skin-close warmth is like an olfactory hug you can carry with you.

listings.rawTitle: MALIN + GOETZ Bergamot Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the sun-drenched shores of Italy with this bergamot-centric fragrance, a haze of fresh citrus, bitter spices and earthy aromas. If you’re looking for a timeless fragrance, you’ve come to the right realm of the fragrancesphere. MALIN + GOETZ’S Bergamot Eau de Parfum unites peppery notes, sharp citrus and warm woods for a refreshing burst that effortlessly evolves into a smooth, heady fragrance. Top notes of bergamot and distinctive bell pepper start to delight your senses, as zesty ginger and spicy cardamom intermingle at the heart of this sparkling aroma, before evolving into a musky, sandalwood and amberwood base. Prepare for a flurry of “what is that fragrance you’re wearing?”...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: A precious and alluring fragrance with a mysterious character, Jo Malone London’s Oud and Bergamot Cologne Intense offers a daring scent juxtaposition of a fresh citrus fruit with a smoky wood accord. The fragrance opens with crisp bergamot, uplifting the senses with its sparkling aroma. A heart of cedarwood lends a dry twist, mingling with rich oud. Central to Middle Eastern fragrance tradition, the wood adds intensity and depth to the cologne, offering a captivating finish.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: A precious and alluring fragrance with a mysterious character, Jo Malone London’s Oud and Bergamot Cologne Intense offers a daring scent juxtaposition of a fresh citrus fruit with a smoky wood accord. Central to Middle Eastern fragrance tradition, the wood adds intensity and depth to the cologne, offering a captivating finish.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: Tuberose transforms as day turns to night, and Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum (50ml) bottles that shift in full bloom. Opening with notes of bergamot, pink pepper and fresh green notes, the fragrance moves into a heart of tuberose, jasmine and osmanthus before settling on a rich base of sandalwood, patchouli and soft white oud. Part of the Fleurs de Nuit collection, it's presented in a midnight-blue pleated bottle with a gold-toned cap, designed to be worn solo or layered for a floral-woody scent.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Hand Pomade Basil 55ml
listings.description: Treat your hardworking hands to a dose of TLC with Le Labo's Hand Pomade Basil (55ml). Starring hydrating sweet almond, nourishing shea butter and soothing peony root extract, this non-greasy formula deeply replenishes skin and protects from any environmental aggressors (read: UV, wind and pollution). It also boasts the brand's signature citrus scent, blended with its herbaceous namesake and notes of verbana (clusters of small purple flowers which smell like sparkling lemon). We recommend keeping one in your bag, one on your desk and even one on your nightstand, so you never have to be without it.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barenia Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hermès' Barénia Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable (100ml) is a captivating blend of woody and lightly floral notes. At the heart of its fragrance profile sits subtle accords of butterfly lily and miracle berry, which give way to rich base notes of oak and patchouli that linger on the skin long after you've spritzed. The elegant aroma has an equally sophisticated bottle to match (inspired by some of the house's most famous fine jewellery), balancing elliptical glass curves with a stud-adorned metal plate. Plus, it's refillable too, so you never have to be without your new signature scent again...

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Hair Rituel By Sisley Volumizing Spray 150ml
listings.description: Ready to take on humidity while lifting your tresses from the root - Hair Rituel by Sisley's Volumising Spray is set to become your new everyday essential. Think of it as a caffeine boost for your locks. Supercharged with boswellia gum, this texturising spray provides support from the root to create a lifting effect. It also contains a volumising resin, alongside rice bran protein and fortifying pro vitamin-B5 for shiny locks that are full of body and vitality. This non-sticky formula is weightless and humidity resistant and true to Hair Rituel by Sisley's sensorial signature, the delicious scent adds a nice finishing touch.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Lavender & White Cedar Linen Spray 100ml
listings.description: Transform your home into a sanctuary of calm with the Jo Malone London Lavender & White Cedar Linen Spray (100ml), a sophisticated bedroom spray that elevates everyday moments. Infused with the soothing aroma of English lavender and the crisp elegance of white cedar, this botanical mist refreshes and fragrances your linens, towels and more, turning simple textiles into an indulgent sensory experience. Whether spritzed over bed linens, pillows, or even tablecloths, it creates a tranquil atmosphere that invites relaxation and luxury. Light, fresh and effortlessly elegant, this linen spray captures the essence of a serene retreat, bringing a touch of the brand’s signature sophistication into every corner of your space.

listings.rawTitle: WHO IS ELIJAH Poetic Dance EDP 10ML
listings.description: Bottling the art of transformation, Poetic Dance from Who is Elijah (10ml) is an expressive, suitably mysterious scent holding untold stories, moods and moments all waiting to be written by you. Dreamy and evocative, this radiant composition moves with the delicacy of a butterfly's wing, opening with the honeyed softness of ripe fig, entwined in the earthy essence of bright bergamot. As the fragrance settles, its poeticism comes into sharp focus with the creamy warmth of tonka bean and powdery allure of heliotrope blooms.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: The Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau de Toilette straddles between modernity and storybook romance. Triggering your senses with an excitable blend of unexpected spices and zinginess, this balanced fragrance explores the depths of a forbidden union like no other. Speaking in volumes for the feelings left unsaid, this expressive aroma dances with pulse-quickening danger, smitten spices and scents for a truly complex fragrance. Oozing with surprisingly warm notes of spicy peach and earthy patchouli which become intertwined with notes of jasmine and rose, what's not to love? Subtly adrongynous, this notable scent is sure to have everyone asking for your secret... or even professing their undying love for you. Whichever comes first...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Picture yourself walking through a Hawaiian tropical forest, stopping to smell a beautiful and rare flower... that's the inspiration behind the Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense (50ml). Exotic and enchanting, this sensual scent is warm and rich, thanks to heady red hibiscus (the rarer relative of the yellow hibiscus), sweet and musky jasmine sambac, cosy vanilla and spicy ylang ylang, which transports you to a paradisical world... so grab your plane ticket (or a bottle of this special scent), and stop to inhale its wonders... after all, taking a breather is always a good idea.

listings.rawTitle: Liis Lucienne Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Step into a world of renewal and inspiration with Liis' Lucienne Eau de Parfum (50ml), a radiant aroma that embraces floral, citrus and aquatic tones. Zesty notes of pomelo, lemon peel and dragon fruit awaken the senses with a bright energy, while layers of crisp magnolia, ethereal water lily and pitahaya lend a profound yet crystalline depth. As for the base? You are met with a blend of sea notes and ambergris. Each spritz of this scent captures a moment of sublime clarity, an invitation to rediscover the world with a fresh and uplifting perspective.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian BACCARAT ROUGE 540 Eau de Parfum 3*11ml
listings.description: The fragrance that captured countless hearts, Maison Francis Kurkdjian's Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum has made its way into fragrance wardrobes across the globe thanks to its show-stopping amber scent. Arriving in three travel-sized vials, this atomiser set allows you to keep spritzing on the go without the need for your full-sized bottle. Celebrated for its crystalline opening of jasmine flowers that flow into sophisticated saffron, this iconic scent is instantly recognisable from the offset. A mineral middle of ambergris offers a woody tone, weaving its way throughout the blend before a sensual base of ambroxan caresses the skin with gourmand warmth. An inimitable scent with a long-lasting sillage, keep yours in your purse, carry-on or clutch so your signature scent is always within reach. CONTENTS: 3 x Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum (11ml)

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Capture the essence of endless summer with Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum (100ml), a radiant, floral-fruity scent that evokes sun-kissed skin and golden hours. Bursting with luminous notes of coconut, ylang-ylang and monoi, this fragrance envelops you in warm, sensual sunshine. Top notes of bergamot, freesia and coconut create an invigorating start, while the heart blooms with gardenia, orange blossom and ylang-ylang, adding a lush, floral dimension. A base of vanilla, ambroxan and musks leaves a soft, seductive trail reminiscent of sun-warmed skin. Perfect for daytime in summer or whenever you crave a sun-drenched escape, it’s an intoxicating ode to radiant femininity and effortless allure.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Capture the essence of endless summer with Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum (50ml), a radiant, floral-fruity scent that evokes sun-kissed skin and golden hours. Bursting with luminous notes of coconut, ylang-ylang and monoi, this fragrance envelops you in warm, sensual sunshine. Top notes of bergamot, freesia and coconut create an invigorating start, while the heart blooms with gardenia, orange blossom and ylang-ylang, adding a lush, floral dimension. A base of vanilla, ambroxan and musks leaves a soft, seductive trail reminiscent of sun-warmed skin. Perfect for daytime in summer or whenever you crave a sun-drenched escape, it’s an intoxicating ode to radiant femininity and effortless allure.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Centaurus 100ml
listings.description: Embrace a warm and timeless olfactory offering with The House of Creed's Centaurus. Opening with fiery top notes, this fragrance blends spicy cardamom, cinnamon, and black pepper with smoky tobacco. It then blooms into a floral-woody heart of almondy heliotrope, patchouli, jasmine, geranium and creamy sandalwood, before revealing its resinous base of benzoin, tolu balsam and ambroxan. Spritz it all over till your heart's content and be prepared to be stopped in the street as people ask you what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Centaurus 50ml
listings.description: Embrace a warm and timeless olfactory offering with The House of Creed's Centaurus. Opening with fiery top notes, this fragrance blends spicy cardamom, cinnamon, and black pepper with smoky tobacco. It then blooms into a floral-woody heart of almondy heliotrope, patchouli, jasmine, geranium and creamy sandalwood, before revealing its resinous base of benzoin, tolu balsam and ambroxan.
