listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Ludeaux Eau de Parfum  50ml
listings.description: The Vyrao Ludeaux Eau de Parfum (50ml) is an irresistible fragrance that combines creamy milky peach with floral notes of osmanthus, jasmine and magnolia. The heart is enriched with warm amyris and soothing sandalwood, elevated by stimulating tonka bean and bright, exhilarating ambrette, adding depth and energy. Ambrox and musk at the base deepens the allure, while a cheeky hint of latex adds an unexpected twist. Perfect for unleashing your inner flirt and embracing confidence, this is a bold yet elegant scent that leaves a memorable impression wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela REPLICA From the Garden Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to a sunny afternoon spent outdoors with Maison Margiela's From the Garden Eau de Toilette (100ml). Opening with notes that are reminiscent of picking ripe vegetables, this fragrance calls on fresh tomato leaf accords and the bright, citrusy tones from green mandarin and grapefruit. The uplifting tones are contrasted with earthy and humid qualities that spicy patchouli and sweet-minty geranium brings. Let the aromatics of this invigorating scent linger on your skin as you take in and appreciate nature's beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum 9ml
listings.description: Enter a moment of serene bliss with the Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum (9ml) from fresh. Bursting with mouthwatering notes, this fragrance opens with a bright citrus blend of grapefruit, lime blossom and Amalfi lemon. It then blooms into a heart of fruity lychee, floral freesia and soft lotus petals. After being met with a bouquet, base accords of amber, sandalwood and tonka beans balances this perfume to have a warmer, creamy dry down. It's like stepping out into a field of flowers, lined by fruit-filled trees.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Izia 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by roses, SISLEY-PARIS’ Izia fragrance is designed to evoke a romance in bloom. A little seductive and very sophisticated, it’ll make an elegant addition to your olfactory lineup. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml, Izia evokes a distinctive floral bouquet with sensual undertones. Radiant top notes of white bergamot and pink pepper are made all the more seductive with rose d’Ornano, jasmine, peony and lily of the valley. The musky base adds a sensual finish, rounding off this unique and modern fragrance with warming cedar and amber. Perfect for day or night — just note that wearing this scent may attract admirers.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum for Women 150ml
listings.description: Tuberose transforms as day turns to night, and Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum (150ml) bottles that shift in full bloom. Opening with notes of bergamot, pink pepper and fresh green notes, the fragrance moves into a heart of tuberose, jasmine and osmanthus before settling on a rich base of sandalwood, patchouli and soft white oud. Part of the Fleurs de Nuit collection, it's presented in a midnight-blue pleated bottle with a gold-toned cap, designed to be worn solo or layered for a floral-woody scent.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum (50ml) captures the sunlit softness of blooming mimosa in the hills of Grasse. Bright notes of petit grain, cardamom and blackcurrant open the fragrance, melting into golden mimosa, neroli and jasmine sambac. A grounding blend of cypress and ambrox adds subtle woody warmth. Worn alone or layered within the Atelier des Fleurs collection, the scent lingers on the skin, leaving a rich olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Souffle De Parfum Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Described by Guerlain as 'a perfumed caress', this eau de parfum revisits the iconic and original Shalimar fragrance and updates it for the modern scent wardrobe. Bursting with citrus fruits, jasmine, white musks and vanilla notes, this olfactory special takes you back in time to India many centuries ago, to a love that knew no bounds. The emperor Shah Jahan ordered the creation of the most luxurious gardens (Shalimar) for his beloved wife, the princess Mumtaz Mahal, to create a setting for their love. Later, he erected the Taj Mahal, a marvel admired by the entire world. This fabulous story inspired Jacques Guerlain to create an exquisitely seductive scent, the world's very first oriental fragrance. And now you get to wear it too, this time in a modern interpretation as the Souffle de Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Guerlain's romantic fragrance is inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means ""temple of love"" in Sanskrit. "Its fresh and delicious flight becomes a sensual mist, as you discover vanilla and the powdery notes within its soft and sensual base", says Jacques Guerlain, the brand's House Perfumer of this mythic fragrance. As for the bottle? It dates back to 1925 when designer Raymond Guerlain won first prize at the Paris Decorative Arts Exhibition. Its curves were inspired by the basins of the famous Shalimar gardens. The fan stopper with its sapphire transparency recalls the garden's eternally gushing water. In other words, it's a true objet d'art for your vanity.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Rose Morning Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by an early summer afternoon in an Italian meadow, fresh's Hesperides Grapefruit Eau de Parfum (100ml) is a bright fragrance. Opening with crisp notes of pink grapefruit wrapped in a citrus medley of lemon and mandarin, this refreshing scent then blooms into a heart of bergamot, lotus and jasmine for a spicy, floral touch. Need more convincing? It's sweetened by accords of rhubarb, peach and musk at the base. What are you waiting for? Get spritzing...

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense (30ml) is a bold and modern fragrance, infused with just four raw ingredients: lavender, jasmine, vanilla and sandalwood. Evoking an evocative woody-amber aroma, this fragrance boasts an artisan-produced vanilla tincture, using a blend of vanilla Tahitensis and patchouli. This is layered with lavender and sandalwood to create an addictive finish that's both elegant and mysterious. It's housed in the brand's iconic 'Quadrilobie' bottle, created in 198(x), which is designed to express contemporary femininity with its strong lines and sensual curves. Keep yours pride of place on your vanity, and don't be surprised if this becomes your new signature.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Entirely Aurner Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Entirely Aurner Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a captivating fragrance of layered complexity, blending shimmering accords of patchouli, Roman chamomile and pink pepper with the rich, herbaceous depth of magnolia leaf. This scent challenges conventions, evoking an intriguing tension between floral delicacy and earthy resilience. The heart of the fragrance reveals a radiant aura of silver ore iridescence, while warm sandalwood and cedar provide a grounding base. Housed in a sleek amber bottle with a basalt-inspired textured cap, it’s a scent for the enigmatic, the alchemists and the explorers; those unafraid to stand apart and embrace their unique essence. A poetic statement of boldness and subtlety intertwined.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian À LA ROSE Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: An ode to rose, the À LA ROSE Eau de Parfum (35ml) by Maison Francis Kurkdijan tells of a love for floral, expressed through the soft elegance of Damascena and Centifolia roses. Made with over 250 freshly bloomed Centifolia roses in every bottle, this radiant fragrance unites its gentle backdrop with sensual, honeyed accents for depth and dimension. Building on one another, notes of sweet pea and powdered violet provide a touch of gourmand, while a plush musk base grants scent longevity and strength on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian 724 Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Inspired by the light of a clear sky across an urban landscape, Maison Francis Kurkdijan's 724 Eau de Parfum (35ml) invites you to feel the vibrant energy of the city. Expertly balanced, this floral-musky fragrance finds its rhythm in notes of bergamot and a bouquet of white flowers, opening with a luminous, slightly citrus, blend. These fresh facets are enhanced by the versatility of aldehydes, refining the scent with an air of sophistication, before an enveloping base of sandalwood and white musk lend a well-rounded, milky trail. Comforting yet contemporary, this eau de parfum is perfect for everyday freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Bergamotto La Spugnatura Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover the rare elegance of the Acqua di Parma Bergamotto la Spugnatura Eau de Parfum (100ml), a limited-edition fragrance that elevates bergamot to new heights of softness and shimmer. Housed in a handmade porcelain bottle, adorned with a delicate white and gold bergamot pattern, this scent captures the essence of Calabria’s prized citrus. Opening with bright notes of bergamot, bitter orange, mandarin and grapefruit, it blossoms into a lush green heart of galbanum and geranium. The dry-down reveals woody cedarwood and vetiver, adding a powdery, warmth that feels both refined and comforting.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Black Tulip Eau De Parfum 50 mL/1.7 fl oz.
Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by high-altitude landscapes, Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum (50ml), is a clean, luminous fragrance transports the senses to snow-covered peaks beneath a clear winter sun. Merging sunlit radiance with snow-dusted freshness, this fragrance evokes the brilliance of light upon alpine peaks. Sparkling bergamot and crisp carrot seed melt into a luminous bouquet of jasmine and orange blossom. Skin-like musk lingers in the brisk, winter air with a solar glow of vanilla and benzoin, capturing a subtle sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Love Eight
listings.description: Discover the transformative power of scent with Vyrao Love Eight Set, a collection of ‘try before you buy’ fragrances. Each uniquely crafted formula features natural, organic ingredients and masterful artistry, creating a symphony of scents that evoke feelings from self-love to grounding. From the luminous floral of Georgette to the fresh, verdant notes of I am Verdant, the collection offers a diverse olfactory journey. Enclosed in a beautiful heart-shaped box, these portable scents are perfect for on-the-go moments, allowing you to explore and embody different energies wherever life takes you. Contents: Georgette Eau de Parfum (2ml) I am Verdant Eau de Parfum (2ml) Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum (2ml) Magnetic 70 Eau de Parfum (2ml) Free 00 Eau de Parfum (2ml) The Sixth Eau de Parfum (2ml) Sun Ræ Eau de Parfum (2ml) Mamajuju Eau de Parfum (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela REPLICA Celestial Whispers Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Experience the serene and protective aura of Maison Margiela's Celestial Whispers Eau de Parfum (100ml), a fragrance that transports you to a tranquil, dreamlike realm. This scent features a surreal celestial smoke accord, evoking wisps of white smoke rising into a halo of positive energy. The top notes of smoky incense and luminous aldehydes create a luminous, warm opening that feels both fiery and protective, reminiscent of ancient rituals connecting to the celestial. The heart reveals a soft iris accord and rich myrrh, adding depth and serenity. Anchored by Madagascan bourbon vanilla, musks and Virginia cedarwood, this scent envelops you in a comforting, mystical embrace.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum (100ml) is a fruity-floral scent that provides a sensual trail built around the beauty and power of its hero ingredient: the rose. Opening with black cherry, this irresistible fragrance boasts an enigmatic blend of almond, berries and bergamot. The second twirl takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, tonka bean appears, leading you into almond seduction, highlighted by black tea for a smoky concoction. Prepare to become obsessed as you celebrate la joie de vivre and irreverence.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Pomegranate Noir Body Crème - 175ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London's Pomegranate Noir Body Crème (175ml) is the ultimate indulgence for any beauty enthusiast. It makes a great gift, but be sure to take one home for yourself, too. Encapsulating daring sensuality in its exotic aroma, this luxurious body cream turns at-home rituals into spa-worthy treatments. Its enigmatic fragrance is centred around the rich juices of the pomegranate, sparked with pink pepper and Casablanca lily before revealing smoky guaiac wood and patchouli. As for the nourishing skin care benefits? This rich and oh-so creamy formula is infused with conditioning oils, including jojoba and cocoa seed, as well as sweet almond. Your skin is left feeling beautifully soft, nourished and hydrated, and smelling incredible.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Purple Trouble Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Unleash your wild side with Juliette Has a Gun’s Purple Trouble (7.5ml), a daring, modern fragrance that blends untamed fruit with a spicy twist for a truly addictive scent. Expect a daring olfactory journey built around a juicy wild blackberry, layered with an unexpected burst of red chili pepper that adds a hint of trouble. This luminous, modern fragrance captures the raw, natural character of ripe berries, amplified by a subtle spicy edge that sparks intrigue. Rich musks and decadent ambroxan ground the scent, leaving a sensual, skin-like trail that’s both vibrant and seductive.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Vanilla Bourbon Eau De Parfum 50 mL/1.7 fl oz.
NEST New York Golden Nectar Travel Spray 8 mL/.27 fl oz.
TRUDON Carmen Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Discover the captivating allure of Trudon Carmen Parfum (15ml) a sophisticated scent that elevates the house’s legendary legacy into an intimate, skin-focused expression. Bright top notes of bergamot, grapefruit and rum give way to a rich heart of leather, tobacco, oak and clove, exuding warmth and depth. Anchored by a base of patchouli, labdanum, ambroxan and moss, this fragrance unfolds with a complex, textured evolution on the skin. Crafted by Émilie Bouge at 15% concentration, this scent offers remarkable longevity and a bold, refined signature, an olfactory masterpiece of modern elegance and timeless character.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Lychee Rose Eau De Parfum 50 mL/1.7 fl oz.
listings.description: Step into a summer garden party with the NEST New York Lychee Rose Eau de Parfum (50ml), a sparkling scent with notes of pink champagne. Compliments, incoming... Enchant and enthral with this delectable scent, featuring a vibrant combination of rose absolute and fresh lychee. Elsewhere in this fragrance dream team, bubbling pink champagne and a hint of raspberry come together to create an effervescent aroma. Whether you use it alone or layer with other NEST New York scents (sold separately), simply spray onto your wrists and inhale for a moment of sheer joy.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the spirit and confidence of the Chloé woman, L'Eau de Parfum Intense (50ml) is an addictive floral fragrance that embodies joy, optimism and freedom. The scent opens with vibrant, juicy notes of raspberry, perfectly balanced by the sensuality of rose at its heart. At the base, a warm bouquet of ambery woods emerges, featuring musky ambrox, soft cashmeran and cedar for a refined finish.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Angel's Powder Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: BORNTOSTANDOUT Angel's Powder Eau De Parfum (50ml) captures the essence of childhood nostalgia. Swirls of icing sugar and the distinct scent of nail polish is infused with a dash of pink pepper, offering an unexpected twist. As it evolves, sweet vanilla sugar, raspberry and soft cotton candy lead into a dreamy heart, settling into a base of heliotrope and white musks. The result? An addictive fragrance delivers a sweet escape into memories of the past.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Juliette Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Unleash your inner modern heroine with Juliette Has a Gun Juliette Eau de Parfum (100ml) a daring fragrance that embodies untamed femininity, power and passion. Led by the seductive dark cherry and vibrant pink berries, this fragrance is a bold statement of confidence. Heart notes of jasmine absolute add a fruity floral nuance, while cashmere weaves a mysterious, woody undertone. Perfect for those who want to stand out and command attention, this exudes a rebellious elegance with a hint of flirtation. It’s a captivating olfactory narrative, a modern ode to strength, allure and individuality that leaves a lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Le Flacon Coeur Eau de Parfum 20ml
listings.description: Presented in a decadent heart bottle designed for on the go, Guerlain's La Petite Robe Noire Le Flacon Cœur Eau de Parfum (28ml) is here to turn heads wherever you are. Inspired by inimitable Parisian style, this refillable hero is a fruity-floral scent that provides a sensual trail built around the beauty and power of its hero ingredient: the rose. Opening with black cherry, this irresistible fragrance boasts an enigmatic blend of almond, berries and bergamot. The second twirl takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, tonka bean appears, leading you into almond seduction, highlighted by black tea for a smoky concoction. Prepare to become obsessed...

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Unleash your inner femme fatale with Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum (100ml) a sophisticated take on tropical gourmand that’s as playful as it is luxurious. This elevated banana fragrance opens with a confident burst of ripe banana and maple syrup, creating a sweet yet refined introduction. A lush heart of coconut and frangipani adds a tropical twist, while the base of vanilla and sandalwood grounds the scent with a warm, sensual depth. Whether you’re seeking a signature scent with a fun edge or a tropical escape in a bottle, this fragrance delivers a memorable, positive vibe that’s irresistibly inviting.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Muscara Parfum Travel Spray 15ml
listings.description: Sultry and primal, Balenciaga’s Muscara Parfum (15ml) is the smouldering, kohl-lined gaze of 1960s couture models. South American ambrette seed absolute meets slick iris accord, creating a warm, hypnotic fragrance with a lacquered, almost varnish-like profile. Dark, cinematic and glossy, it sparks a tension between artifice and allure. With an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, this striking scent bridges the house's storied heritage with its modern vision.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Pomegranate Noir Bath Oil - 250ml
listings.description: Dark, enigmatic and utterly addictive, you'll be craving bath time at all hours with the Pomegranate Noir Bath Oil (250ml) from Jo Malone London. Encapsulating daring sensuality in its exotic aroma, this luxurious bathing oil is the perfect gift for a loved one (or yourself). Centred around the rich juices of the pomegranate, this olfactory treat is sparked with pink pepper and Casablanca lily before revealing smoky guaiac wood and patchouli. As for the nourishing skin care benefits? It's enriched with sweet almond, jojoba seed and avocado oils, all of which are natural conditioners that help to soften and hydrate the skin. If you share a bathroom with someone, we suggest hiding the sleek (and hotel-worthy!) bottle somewhere only you can find it, because the temptation to use it all in one go is strong.

listings.rawTitle: WHO IS ELIJAH Muse 50ml
listings.description: WHO IS ELIJAH Muse Eau de Parfum (50ml) embodies the art of effortless presence. It’s the scent of someone who moves through the world with quiet confidence, bare skin under oversized silk and leather, a glance that lingers without effort, a mood that subtly shifts the room’s energy. It’s the whisper before the kiss, the song you rewind, the feeling that stays just out of reach but is impossible to forget. Crafted with notes of solar warmth, warm florals, jasmine absolute and a trail of ambergris, ambroxan and woody musk, Muse leaves an indelible impression; subtle, seductive and utterly magnetic.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Rosa Damascena Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Bright, spicy and sumptuously floral, Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Rosa Damascena Eau de Parfum (150ml) celebrates the timeless beauty of the rose in all its nuance. Opening with a blend of mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper, the fragrance unfolds into a heart of rosa damascena, delicately layered with Taif rose for depth and freshness. Cedarwood, patchouli and soft musk anchor the scent, leaving a warm lingering trail. Presented in Chloé's pleated glass bottle with ivory and gold-toned detailing, the scent can be layered or worn solo.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: The Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum (150ml) captures the sunlit softness of blooming mimosa in the hills of Grasse. Bright notes of petit grain, cardamom and blackcurrant open the fragrance, melting into golden mimosa, neroli and jasmine sambac. A grounding blend of cypress and ambrox adds subtle woody warmth. Worn alone or layered within the Atelier des Fleurs collection, the scent lingers on the skin, leaving a rich olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Black Cedarwood & Juniper Aftershave Moisturiser 45ml
listings.description: Is that post-shave feeling getting you down? Fret no more with Jo Malone London's Black Cedarwood & Juniper Aftershave Moisturiser (45ml). Lightweight and soothing, this treatment is formulated with hydrating hyaluronic acid and antioxidants, which shield your skin from environmental stressors. What's more, it's infused with a sensual, woody scent featuring notes of black cedarwood and juniper, making for a multisensory experience. Use day or night, after shaving or just every day for consistent hydration.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Rozu Arises Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Rozu Arises Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fragrant fable of blooming strength, capturing the journey of the rose from thorny stems to radiant blossoms. This scent intertwines green, floral and woody notes, with top hints of pink pepper, shiso and rose, evoking the resilience of a thorn. The heart reveals jasmine, guaiacwood and vetiver, embodying growth and depth, while the base of patchouli and myrrh grounds the fragrance in earthy richness. Encased in a sleek amber bottle with a basalt-inspired textured cap, it invites pioneers, cultivators and trailblazers to embrace their unfolding story, celebrating beauty in resilience and transformation.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Boundless Eremia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Boundless Erémia Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fragrant fable rooted in the vitality of verdant shoots emerging through cracks in concrete. This fresh, herbaceous scent blends citrusy yuzu, bergamot and grapefruit with the green richness of tomato leaf, basil and iris; conjuring images of nature’s quiet rebellion in urban landscapes. Accentuated by notes of mimosa, green tea and guaiacwood, it embodies freedom and resilience. Encased in a sleek amber bottle with a basalt-inspired textured cap, this fragrance is a poetic ode to vitality, inviting you to embrace your unyielding spirit.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Journey to Ouranon Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Journey to Ouranon Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fragrant fable wrapped in smoky, mineral-rich depths, evoking images of glowing embers and ribbons of perfumed smoke. This evocative scent blends woody, spicy notes with resinous warmth, anchored by accords of myrrh, patchouli and frankincense, while top notes of petitgrain and lavender add a fresh, invigorating edge. Crafted to inspire transformation and renewal, it is a fragrance rooted in the idea of reinvention, like ashes turning to new beginnings. Housed in a sleek amber bottle with a basalt-inspired textured cap, it’s a poetic ode to the power of scent to tell stories and spark introspection.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Eternal Karst Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Eternal Karst Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fresh, herbaceous fragrance that evokes the crashing waves and gleaming wet stones of windswept coastlines. With invigorating top notes of calone, sage and pink pepper, it conjures the shimmering energy of sea foam, while a calming base of sandalwood, cedar and vetiver grounds the scent in earthy resilience. Inspired by coastal cliffs that stand unwavering against the elements, it’s a fragrance for the pragmatic dreamers and explorers; those who seek strength in nature’s enduring landscapes. Housed in a sleek amber bottle with a basalt-inspired textured cap, it invites you to embrace the beauty of resilience and self-discovery.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Alma 50ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. This Alma scent artfully blends aquatic iris with frosty cardamom to create a delicate and alluring finish. Described by SISLEY-PARIS as ‘an iris between water and ice’, L’Eau Rêvée d’Alma was inspired by the French countryside — depicting a landscape brimming with reeds, rivers and ponds. It opens with top notes of cardamom, bergamot and basil before revealing crisp jasmine, rose and of course, the heart of the fragrance: iris. Vetiver, cedarwood and patchouli round it off nicely with a warm and woody base. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Hibiscus Abelmoschus Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An ode to the hibiscus flower, the Atelier des Fleurs Hibiscus Abelmoschus Eau de Parfum (50ml) by Chloé interprets its floral facets through a trio of seeds. Spotlighting the lesser-known nuances of the flower, this fragrance magnifies the ambery, aromatic notes of ambrette seed, angelica seed and carrot flower seed. Illuminated by bergamot and pear, this delectable essence unfolds onto a warm, powdery base of tonka and vanilla bean, seamlessly blended to reveal hibiscus from a whole new perspective.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Parfum Mystique 100ml
listings.description: Embrace radiant depth with Trudon Parfum Mystique Eau de Parfum (100ml), a luminous blend of velvety florals and glowing amber warmth. Opulent petals intertwine with balsamic resins and soft woods, creating a fragrance that feels rich yet weightless. Smooth and sensual, it settles into a warm, elegant finish that lingers beautifully on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Hubert 100ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. The Hubert thrives in its masculinity, packing a powerful olfactory punch with aromatic geranium and minty green leaves. Described by SISLEY-PARIS as a ‘masculine rose’, L’eau Rêvée d’Hubert opens with a breath of peppermint, shiso and bucchu leaves before revealing its geranium heart, combined with earthy papyrus and cedarwood. It’s rounded off with woody notes of ambroxan, oakmoss and patchouli. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Ice(d)- Personal 100ml
listings.description: Made with soft, molecular notes, the Ice(d)- Personal fragrance (100ml) by Commodity is for you and the ones you allow close. A frozen mango's melted edges, topped with crisp spearmint and eucalyptus nuances open this aquatic blend. Sheer marine notes of seaweed are enveloped by skin musk, giving way to a gentle freshness that invigorates the senses each time you catch the aroma lingering on your body or clothes. Intimate, inviting and irresistible, wear this customisable fragrance alone or layer with one of the brand's signature blends.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Velvet- Personal 100ml
listings.description: A unique signature scent, Commodity's Velvet- Personal (100ml) reveals an unexpectedly delicate yet smoky silage on the skin. Perfect for those who want to savour their scent and hold it close, this light rendition blends subtle accents of iso e super with sweet clove bud. Then, as the minutes pass and the scent come to life, you'll begin to notice delicate rose petals striking the just-right balance between soft and inviting. Finally, at the base you are met with creamy, woody accords of skin musks, amber and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Moss Expressive 100ml
listings.description: Fresh, green and citrusy, Commodity's Moss Expressive (100ml) transports the senses to state of tranquillity. Perfect for those who want more out of their fragrance wardrobe, this warm rendition blends subtle accents of bergamot with green petitgrain. Then, as the minutes pass and the scent come to life, you'll begin to notice the rise of oakmoss, an earthy aroma reminiscent of a lush forest floor. Finally, at the base you are met with creamy, woody accords of amber and skin musk.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Gold- Personal 100ml
listings.description: Open up your inner world (read: personal space) to an air of delectably sweet notes thanks to Commodity's Gold- Personal Eau de Parfum (100ml). Perfect for those who want to savour their scent and hold it close, this light rendition blends delicate accents of vanilla with the molecular note of Iso E Super. Subtle but hard-to-miss traces of amber and sandalwood begin to pull through after a few minutes, striking the just-right balance between soft and inviting.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Izia La Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: An ode to the mystery of the night, SISLEY-PARIS’ Izia La Nuit is quite simply temptation bottled — the glossy packaging is the artistic handiwork of Polish sculptor Bronislaw Krzysztof. Inside, expect a tantalising cocktail of forest fruits, florals and woody undertones. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml, Izia La Nuit evokes the allure of hedonistic nights — designed for the bold and daring woman who leaves an air of mystery in her wake. It opens with juicy blackcurrant, mandarin and warming cardamom, balanced with middle notes of d’Ornano rose, freesia and magnolia. The base? Think: woody and sensual with musky ambrox, patchouli and sweet vanilla. Be sure to keep the bottle pride of place when the fragrance runs out — it’s a true work of art.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Muscara Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Sultry and primal, Balenciaga’s Muscara Parfum Refill (200ml) is the smouldering, kohl-lined gaze of 1960s couture models. South American ambrette seed absolute meets slick iris accord, creating a warm, hypnotic fragrance with a lacquered, almost varnish-like profile. Dark, cinematic and glossy, it sparks a tension between artifice and allure. With an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, this striking scent bridges the house's storied heritage with its modern vision.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Getaria Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A transportive fragrance inspired by Cristóbal Balenciaga’s upbringing on the Spanish coast, Getaria Parfum (100ml) evokes the heat of high-summer with a neo-marine edge. A study in contrasts, this aquatic scent opens with salty citrus and pink pepper, evoking the refreshing tang of an ocean breeze sailing across turquoise waters. Overheated, crystallized seaweed absolute from France introduces an unexpected ambery essence, recalling glistening vistas lining Spain's Basque coastline. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, it threads together the fashion house’s past and present.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Getaria Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: A transportive fragrance inspired by Cristóbal Balenciaga’s upbringing on the Spanish coast, Getaria Parfum Refill (200ml) evokes the heat of high-summer with a neo-marine edge. A study in contrasts, this aquatic scent opens with salty citrus and pink pepper, evoking the refreshing tang of an ocean breeze sailing across turquoise waters. Overheated, crystallized seaweed absolute from France introduces an unexpected ambery essence, recalling glistening vistas lining Spain's Basque coastline. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, it threads together the fashion house’s past and present.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Hibiscus Abelmoschus Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: An ode to the hibiscus flower, the Atelier des Fleurs Hibiscus Abelmoschus Eau de Parfum (150ml) by Chloé interprets its floral facets through a trio of seeds. Spotlighting the lesser-known nuances of the flower, this fragrance magnifies the ambery, aromatic notes of ambrette seed, angelica seed and carrot flower seed. Illuminated by bergamot and pear, this delectable essence unfolds onto a warm, powdery base of tonka and vanilla bean, seamlessly blended to reveal hibiscus from a whole new perspective.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Alabaster Atria 270g
listings.description: Replacing the traditional green-glass is delicate alabaster, these candles are not only luxurious scents for your space, but make for stunning sculptural centrepieces (complete with a matching top). Exclusive to The Alabasters range, Atria captures light with an enticing powdery touch. Reminiscent of a feminine figure, this evokes the soft and delicate touch of the skin that begins with a welcoming floral top note of geranium. As this indulgent scent disperses itself throughout your space, heart notes of iris, cashmere wood and iris reveal themselves before melting into a pool of a leathery, musky base. The ultimate interior accessory, this balances the art of fragrance with covetable sculptural prowess.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® L'Animal Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Unleashing your inner desires, BORNTOSTANDOUT's L'Animal Eau De Parfum (50ml) adopts a provocative and primal scent profile. Like a velvety caress, notes of rich rum, nutmeg and creamy almond brush against the skin to open. Accents of soft suede are paired with heliotrope for a fresh, verdant touch, before a smouldering eruption of guaiac wood and sandalwood anchor the base. To close, golden honey and sensuous vanilla nuances grow with intensity as the eau de parfum warms on your pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Sweat, Tears, Paradise 8ml
listings.description: The kick of absinthe and the rhythm of waves, Discothèque's Sweat, Tears, Paradise Eau de Parfum (8ml) is a transcendent blend of samphire, sea salt, mimosa and musk that transports you to Greece and the day-to-night raptures of Cavo Paradiso. A place where you dance like a mortal but feel like a god, Cavo Paradiso - nestled in the cliffs of Mykonos - was built as a 'temple to music'; serving dance-evangelists since 1995, who flock to its idyllic island setting. Conjuring the heady-scented air, the salty breeze, the aniseed of absinthe and the musky tang of ambroxan, this fragrance invokes endless evenings and summers that stretch into warm, balmy autumns. It's the optimistic thrill of golden skin and sun-bleached hair; sunglasses, salt and a beat that erupts to a euphoric drop. And let's not forget the scent's beautiful, cubic glass bottle and 'disco ball' lid, designed to reflect you as much as your signature scent does.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Ikar 50ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. The Ikar is a powerful and evocative choice, inspired by the myth of Icarus and the sun-drenched landscapes of Corsica. L’eau Rêvée d’Ikar is a tribute to the ‘radiant sun, freshness and proud landscapes of Corsica’ where the d’Ornano family often call home. The scent is also named after the Greek figure, Icarus, who famously flew too close to the sun despite warnings and fell to his end — a message that reminds us of our limits. Weaving storytelling into its olfactory offerings, SISLEY-PARIS opens this scent with top notes of lemon, bitter orange and geranium before revealing a heart of lentisk, iris and reed. A warm and woody mix of vetiver and sandalwood creates an unexpected finish. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Eau de Campagne Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the art of French living, this nonchalant unisex fragrance — now available in 50ml and 100ml — harnesses the elegance of nature to inspire a feeling of well-being and calm. Consider it your new everyday luxury. Rich in scents of basil, wild herbs and lemon, SISLEY-PARIS’ Eau de Campagne creates the perfect harmony of citrus and grassy notes with a classic chypre base. At the heart, you’ll find the unique scent of green tomato leaves blended with jasmine, plum, lily of the valley, and geranium to deliver a beautifully fresh and floral accord. Underneath: oakmoss, musk, patchouli and vetiver round it off for a lightly woody and earthy finish. We think it’s a dreamy choice for daytime rendezvous , from alfresco parties to coffee dates.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Love in White for Summer Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Are holiday flings a thing of the past? Not when it comes to The House of Creed's Love in White for Summer Eau de Parfum. This effervescent fragrance opens with a burst of fruity notes, starring juicy apple, tart cranberry, sweet peach and citrusy bergamot. Its brightness is then twisted with a floral fusion that mingles Tuscan iris with light freesia, rich jasmine and fresh magnolia to create a slightly powdery yet full-bodied scent. The warming base of cedarwood adds to the romanticism of this energetic scent. We're head over heels already.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Love in White for Summer Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Are holiday flings a thing of the past? Not when it comes to The House of Creed's Love in White for Summer Eau de Parfum. This effervescent fragrance opens with a burst of fruity notes, starring juicy apple, tart cranberry, sweet peach and citrusy bergamot. Its brightness is then twisted with a floral fusion that mingles Tuscan iris with light freesia, rich jasmine and fresh magnolia to create a slightly powdery yet full-bodied scent. The warming base of cedarwood adds to the romanticism of this energetic scent. We're head over heels already.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Aria 50ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. The Aria stars sensual devilwood and spicy ginger to deliver a tantalising scent with an edge. Described by SISLEY-PARIS as a ‘fantastical costume party’, the L’eau Rêvée d’Alma celebrates the complexity of devilwood — a flower with both peachy and leather notes. In other words, beauty that bites. It opens with bergamot, mandarin and spicy ginger before revealing juicy blackcurrant and warming nutmeg. The base is both sweet and musky to add to the mystery and allure of the fragrance. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Naked Laundry Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: BORNTOSTNADOUT's Naked Laundry (50ml) wraps you in a comforting cocoon of cleanliness with a hint of sensuality. Opening with a sun-dried cotton scent of mandarin and ambrinol, this fragrance captures the soothing essence of warmed laundry. As the perfume dissipates, a honeyed heart of mimosa and white caramel lends a musk-like allure, reminiscent of sheets worn-in by the lingering embrace of bodies on a slow Sunday morning. In the dry down, notes of creamy milk, amber woods and tonka bean absolute unveil a soft, lasting sweetness that clings to the skin with quiet intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Santalum Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: One of the most coveted essences in perfumery, Chloé's Atelier des Fleurs Santalum Eau de Parfum (150ml) reimagines the rare profile of sandalwood. Standing out for its silky, almond-like nuances, this fragrance note lingers on the skin with an opulent intensity. To bring out its many facets, perfumer Marypierre Julien pairs it with bright bergamot, orange oil and mandarin, showcasing its fresh, lighter side. An aromatic blend of florals lends a delicate softness, before settling into the warm embrace of akigalawood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: TOM FORD Bois Pacifique Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody-spicy scent inspired by the warmth and richness of sunlit forests. Turmeric brings a golden heat that blends with creamy sandalwood and smooth oakwood, creating a grounded yet radiant finish. Housed in a gold-toned bottle with ribbed detailing, this eau de parfum is a wearable addition to any scent wardrobe, whether worn alone or layered.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embrace the radiance of sunny days with Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum (100ml) a luminous, fruity musk that captures the joy and freshness of summer. This crisp, lightweight fragrance opens with a bright pear accord, evoking childhood memories and the promise of warm, carefree days. Centred around the iconic cetalox note (famous from Not a Perfume) it offers a clean, modern musk that gently lingers. Completed by subtle hints of ambroxan and musks, it’s a refreshing, slightly gourmand scent that radiates positivity and happiness. Packaged in a striking teal ombre bottle, it’s perfect for uplifting your mood or gifting to someone special. Effortlessly sophisticated, this fragrance is a joyful ode to sunshine and good vibes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Signatures of the Sun Zafferano Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Did you know that saffron (the star of this particular Acqua di Parma fragrance show) is also known as red gold? If that doesn't already sway you to try this olfactory marvel, then the sleek black bottle certainly will. The Signatures Of The Sun Zafferano Eau de Parfum boasts a particular kind of saffron, which is harvested and hand-picked at first dawn where the precious stigmas are protected by the petals of the flower that have not yet blossomed. Here Acqua di Parma takes you on an unexpected journey with spicy notes dancing alongside luminous citrus and white florals, atop woody and amber accords of tonka bean and vanilla. Housed in the brand's iconic and ever-sleek Art Deco-inspired bottle with two sizes available (100ml and 180ml), it'll make a special gift for anyone with an acute case of wanderlust. But we'll also be playing for keeps...

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Purple Trouble Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Unleash your wild side with Juliette Has a Gun’s Purple Trouble (100ml), a daring, modern fragrance that blends untamed fruit with a spicy twist for a truly addictive scent. Expect a daring olfactory journey built around a juicy wild blackberry, layered with an unexpected burst of red chili pepper that adds a hint of trouble. This luminous, modern fragrance captures the raw, natural character of ripe berries, amplified by a subtle spicy edge that sparks intrigue. Rich musks and decadent ambroxan ground the scent, leaving a sensual, skin-like trail that’s both vibrant and seductive.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Black Cedarwood & Juniper Shaving Cream 200ml
listings.description: Here to turn a somewhat mundane task into something a bit more luxurious is Jo Malone London's Black Cedarwood & Juniper Shaving Cream (200ml). This rich formulation preps the skin for a close shave, ensuring all those hairs get lifted while leaving your skin feeling silky-smooth. It's supercharged with a plethora of skin-loving ingredients, from the likes of hydrating hyaluronic acid to moisture-locking glycerine and nourishing shea butter. What's more, it's infused with a sensual, woody scent featuring notes of black cedarwood and juniper, making for a multisensory experience.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Parfum Midnight Omen 100ml
listings.description: Step into shadow with Trudon Midnight Omen Eau de Parfum (100ml), a deep, smouldering scent designed to intrigue. Layering warm spices and smoky incense over a base of rich woods and resinous accords, this enveloping fragrance unfolds slowly on the skin. The finish is smooth, dark and magnetic, which leaves a lingering, sensual trail that feels both bold and refined.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Parfum - Mortel Noir - 100ml
listings.description: Step into the dark allure of Trudon’s Mortel Noir Eau de Parfum (100ml), a fragrance that’s both mysterious and irresistibly seductive. This unisex scent is an intoxicating blend of spicy black pepper and nutmeg opening to a hypnotic heart of Somali frankincense and mystikal notes. The warm, sensual base of benzoin, cistus absolute and myrrh creates an intoxicating aura that feels both powerful and refined. Encased in a matte black bottle with gold accents, it exudes elegance and intrigue. Perfect for those who crave a scent that’s as bold and enigmatic as they are, this perfume transports you to a world of smoky, seductive allure.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Violette 30 Eau De Parfum 100Ml
listings.description: The Le Labo Violette 30 Eau de Parfum (100ml) is an ode to the undefinable contrasts captured in a single, perfect flower. In the secret language of flowers, the violet has always stood for a paradoxical bouquet of meanings; from passion to innocence, strength to delicacy. This scent embraces that complexity, centering around the rare, shadow-seeking white violet to create a fragrance that is at once crystalline and untethered. Its verdant green floral heart is paired with the clean elegance of white tea notes, before settling into a grounding, woody base of cedarwood and a touch of guaiacwood. Familiar yet mysterious, it's a sophisticated study in contradiction, inviting you to embrace your own many multitudes.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Violette 30 Eau De Parfum 50Ml
listings.description: The Le Labo Violette 30 Eau de Parfum (50ml) is an ode to the undefinable contrasts captured in a single, perfect flower. In the secret language of flowers, the violet has always stood for a paradoxical bouquet of meanings; from passion to innocence, strength to delicacy. This scent embraces that complexity, centering around the rare, shadow-seeking white violet to create a fragrance that is at once crystalline and untethered. Its verdant green floral heart is paired with the clean elegance of white tea notes, before settling into a grounding, woody base of cedarwood and a touch of guaiacwood. Familiar yet mysterious, it's a sophisticated study in contradiction, inviting you to embrace your own many multitudes.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense, 60ml
listings.description: Hermès Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense (60ml) opens with a bright burst of bergamot before unfurling into the soft floral accords of butterfly lily. Patchouli absolute adds depth with its earthy richness, while oak settles in with a woody warmth. The composition is smooth yet intriguing, offering a scent that draws you in.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women 75ml
listings.description: Paying homage to the beauty of Egypt, the Chloe Nomade Nuit d'Egypte Eau de Parfum (75ml) combines honeyed florals with sensual ambers. Mingling modern with ancient, this scent is inspired by the first known perfume to humankind, kyphi. Radiant notes of orange blossom intertwin with spiced cinnamon and energising ginger to capture the senses at first spritz. Tied with sensual vanilla, the aroma leaves behind a warming yet creamy, unforgettable trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Velvet Rose and Oud Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Meet your new olfactory obsession, Jo Malone London's Velvet Rose and Oud Cologne Intense (100ml). Think: dark, decadent, and a little spicy. Induge your senses with the textural and magnetic scent of Velvet Rose and Oud Intense. It opens with warm and spicy top notes of clove, before revealing an opulent velvety-smooth heart of Damask rose. The base? Rich, resinous and dark oud rounds it off to bring even more intensity and depth. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès L'Ombre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Looking to create an air of mystery? You'll want to get to know Hermès' L'Ombre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum (50ml)... This spicy, woody aroma boasts a subtle smokiness with deep notes of black tea and incense, enhanced by a side of sweet-but-sultry tonka bean. An aromatic celebration of contrasts (think: light and dark, sweet and spicy), this perfume is created to satisfy the most curious of senses. As for the name? It refers to the final star in the Merveilles constellation, sitting on the edge of dusk and daybreak. If you're looking for your new signature scent, the stars might just be aligning over here...

listings.rawTitle: Hermès L'Ombre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Looking to create an air of mystery? You'll want to get to know Hermès' L'Ombre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum (100ml)... listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Poivrée Eau de Parfum Natural Spray 85ml
listings.description: Do your friends know you for your mischievous character? You need to add the Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Poivrée Eau de Parfum Natural Spray (85ml) to your fragrance wardrobe. A lighter version of the Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Poivrée Eau de Parfum (sold separately), this peppery, spicy spritz begins with pink peppercorn, before evolving into a heart of fresh rose and ending with a rich patchouli base. With a lantern-shaped bottle created by Hermès scarf designer Florence Manlik, the cloudy, coral pink colour of the fragrance inside will look stunning on your vanity. And the final flourish? A hand-tied silk ribbon around the neck of each bottle, which each one being completely unique.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Jasmine Sambac and Marigold Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Find yourself surrounded by an array of blooming florals as dawn rises with Jo Malone London's Jasmine Sambac & Marigold Cologne (100ml). This potent fragrance invites you on an olfactory adventure with its contrasting tones of crispness and warmth. To create its heady rich aroma, it opens onto the fruity, green note of vibrant marigold, and then falls into accords of sophisticated Jasmine Sambac which adds luminosity to the scent. Benzoin resin closes the trail, with warm, vanilla-like undertones to dry down with a subtle, yet compelling, sweetness. If it's a unique and alluring fragrance you're looking for, then you've come to the right place.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Tutti Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 85ml
listings.description: Treat yourself to a warm and sensual spritz with Hermès' Tutti Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum (85ml). A fruity and floral explosion, this fragrance opens with a juicy top note of lychee, which makes for a sweet start. It then blooms into a spicy, fizzy accord of ginger blossom which adds a bright and citrusy spark to this scent. Finally, it mingles on a comforting bed of creamy musk for a soft touch. The cherry on top? It's housed in a lantern-shaped bottle finished with a hand-tied silk ribbon that adds a playful aesthetic to this ensemble.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Imagine if 'glamping' was a perfume? Like a bouquet of fresh herbs you can wear, Hermès' H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum (50ml) cloaks your aura with sense-awakening notes akin to an afternoon in spring. Bursting with a combination of oakmoss, pear granita, sage, rosewood and narcissus, this woody yet slightly sweet fragrance brightens up your scent wardrobe. Going on a lunch date or heading out for a let's-touch-grass adventure? Spritz this verde aroma over pulse points to adorn yourself with delicate, nature-inspired crispness that'll have everyone asking for your perfume details.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Picture yourself walking through a Hawaiian tropical forest, stopping to smell a beautiful and rare flower... that's the inspiration behind the Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense (100ml). Exotic and enchanting, this sensual scent is warm and rich, thanks to heady red hibiscus (the rarer relative of the yellow hibiscus), sweet and musky jasmine sambac, cosy vanilla and spicy ylang ylang, which transports you to a paradisical world... so grab your plane ticket (or a bottle of this special scent), and stop to inhale its wonders... after all, taking a breather is always a good idea.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Lumineuse 100ml
listings.description: Introducing L'Eau de Parfum Lumineuse (100ml), a fresh and radiant floral fragrance to add to your scent repertoire. Opening with velvety jasmine sambac and a luminous rose heart, the scent is softened by a warm vanilla infusion, while amber undertones add depth. Encased in a vintage-inspired glass bottle with a silver cap and hand-tied ribbon, the fragrance leaves a long-lasting floral signature from the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: Paying homage to the beauty of Egypt, the Chloe Nomade Nuit d'Egypte Eau de Parfum (50ml) combines honeyed florals with sensual ambers. listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne Intense Collection 5x9ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London invites you to 'Gingerbread Land' with this sweet and indulgent set of five iconic fragrances, all perfectly sized in mini versions of the brand's instantly recognisable bottles. Just try not to eat the box... Did you know that all of Jo Malone London's fragrances are designed to be worn solo or layered, so you can create your own unique combination? The best part is that there are no rules, only endless opportunities to play and experiment with the brand's Cologne Intense offerings. From the ravishing and moreish Scarlet Poppy to the rich and oh-so mysterious Oud and Bergamot, there's a fragrance to suit every nose, and scent wardrobe. Good luck trying to pick a favourite, we found it impossible... Contents : Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense (9ml) Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense (9ml) Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense (9ml) Velvet Rose & Oud Cologne Intense (9ml) Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense (9ml)

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Meet your new olfactory obsession, Jo Malone London's Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense (100ml). Think: moreish, velvety smooth and delightfully decadent. Expect to be whisked away to the wild steppes of southwest Asia, covered in the extravagant blooms of the great scarlet poppy. Opening with rare and cocooning ambrette, this floral aroma is enhanced with velvety iris and rounded off with sweet and addictive tonka bean. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embrace the radiance of sunny days with Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum (50ml) a luminous, fruity musk that captures the joy and freshness of summer. This crisp, lightweight fragrance opens with a bright pear accord, evoking childhood memories and the promise of warm, carefree days. Centred around the iconic cetalox note (famous from Not a Perfume) it offers a clean, modern musk that gently lingers. Completed by subtle hints of ambroxan and musks, it’s a refreshing, slightly gourmand scent that radiates positivity and happiness. Packaged in a striking teal ombre bottle, it’s perfect for uplifting your mood or gifting to someone special. Effortlessly sophisticated, this fragrance is a joyful ode to sunshine and good vibes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Signatures of the Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Want to bring some fiery sunshine into your scent wardrobe? This opulent fragrance combines the power of oud with vibrant and luminous citrus. This unique fragrance has been created using the oud essence found in Laos, Asia, which is renowned for its exceptional smoothness and balance. These enveloping notes are distilled and combined with the warm, spicy tones of cinnamon and cloves, revealing an unexpected twist. Sunny bergamot and vibrant pink pepper illuminate the composition while raspberry lends an addictive and tasty addition. Finally, the rich facette of rose, the earthiness of patchouli and the sweetness of cisto labdanum create an unforgettable, opulent discovery. Prepare to become obsessed.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Inhale the essence of the English countryside with Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne (50ml). Sparkling rays warm ripe pear flesh as sweet pea flower perfumes the air. A gentle breeze dances through the orchard, greeting tempting green pears amongst the branches. Pastel sweet pea blooms adorn the scene, brimming with garden-fresh elegance. A base of powdery white musk completes this fragrance composition, embracing these ethereal notes with clean depth. A composition to enchant and delight, this is your newest fragrance favourite.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Hinoki & Cedarwood Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London's Hinoki & Cedarwood Cologne Intense (50ml) balances clean, aromatic notes with the smoky intensity of cedarwood and Japanese hinoki tree. This fresh cologne has an intensity that lends itself as well to layering as it does to being worn alone. Its immersive fusion of fresh, woody and elegant notes is inspired by the ritual of forest bathing and the grounding presence of the hinoki tree, found deep in the forests of Japan (we feel relaxed just thinking about it...). The fragrance profile opens with an aromatic clean accord, develops around a heart note of hinoki wood and leaves a lasting scent of characterful cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Homme Idéal Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bring the outdoors in with a spritz of L'Homme Idéal Le Parfum (100ml) from Guerlain, a musky scent boasting deep, woody accords. A reinterpretation of the iconic L'Homme Idéal fragrance, this intense aroma opens with bold amaretto (a bitter almond-flavoured Italian liqueur) and creamy almond only to fall onto bed of earthy leather. To finish? Expect woody accents and intensely captivating patchouli to deliver depth and musk. Presented in a decadent bottle, this luxury perfume is stamped with a darker grey label to reflect the intensity of the seductive fragrance...

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette transports you to a warm Andalusian garden. If you love pomegranate, you'll love this fruity scent. "Granada Salvia is the surprising encounter between mouth-watering pomegranate and fresh sage," says Guerlain's Perfumer, Delphine Jelk. This delectable scent is bursting with sweet and fruity notes of the crimson fruit, amidst blackcurrant, cypress, lemon and bergamot. It's imbued with a twist of sage before landing on a sensual white musk, moss and patchouli base. As with all of the brand's fragrances, it's formulated with more than 90% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The pretty pink bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity, and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Bergamote Calabria Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to take inspiration from nature to create an ode to its unique wonder, the Aqua Allegoria collection aims to inspire you to act for change. Guerlain's bergamot-scented eau de toilette (formulated with ingredients of up to 95% natural origin*) takes you on a journey to the sun-drenched shores of Southern Italy, celebrating the zesty, green floral citrus of this precious fruit. Known as Calabrian green gold, this exquisite fruit is paired with the zesty, botanical air of petitgrain lemon to create a truly lively and uplifting fragrance. Notes of spicy pink peppercorn, cardamom and ginger intertwine with heady white musks to complete this Italian-inspired scent. Designed to top up your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle, you can use this with your fragrance and enjoy your scent for even longer. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Guerlain's Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum (50ml) reveals the intense and sensual signature of woody and leather notes. It's a true classic. With its eternally elegant French appeal, Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum is a passionate and audacious scent that boasts a spicy, woody heart, nuanced with notes of neroli and jasmine. The base blossoms with leather and oud wood, which is tempered by the sweetness of vanilla and patchouli. It's a celebration of the genius of contrast and well-mastered emotions.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to find inspiration, the Aqua Allegoria collection intensifies and enhances fragrant notes that journey to the heart of these destinations. Guerlain's vibrant Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum (75ml) will have everyone asking what you're wearing. It's up to you if you spill the secret! A captivating woody, floral fragrance... if you close your eyes you can almost imagine that you're walking through the neroli-scented landscapes of the Bay of Naples. The essence of intense Calabrian neroli melds with refreshing basil, sun-drenched, woody vetiver and a juicy, fig accord to create a dynamic and elegant aroma. A fragrance that's designed to last, once you've finished your first love affair with this fresh fragrance, you can top up your refillable and recyclable bottle time and time again.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Idylle Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Illustrating a tale of sporadic love encounters with no-holds-barred, the Les Légendaires Idylle Eau de Parfum is an olfactory palette of Bulgarian roses surrounded by a joyful bouquet of lilac and peony against sensual notes of chypre. Housed in an iconic glass bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is exuberant yet delicate. The scent stars peony, freesia and white lilac that blossom into notes of jasmine and Bulgarian roses and settle into a chypre accord. Finally a base tingled with patchouli and white musk make for a smattering of sensuality. A tantalising and harmonious fragrance, this scent is a hymn of the whirlwind of love and all the memorable emotions that linger, bringing a fond smile to your face.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Après L'Ondée Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by scenes of lingering rain giving way to sunshine, and a romantic encounter, the Les Légendaires Après L'Ondée Eau de Toilette bursts with floral notes based on carnations and irises that give way to woody accents and spicy aromas. Housed in an iconic, avant-garde bottle, this evocative fragrance is sentimental yet assertive. The scent opens with a blossoming bouquet of flowers including iris and violet accord along with sweet vanilla. Imbued in the "mute flower" that is carnation is an interpretative blend of rose and spices, while the precious iris exudes woody accents for grounding. An oregano accord also lends a touch of orange and clove. Just a spritz of this scent will transport you to a misty woodland where a dream encounter awaits.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal L'Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Housed in an elegant, square bottle boasting a strong impression, the L'Homme Idéal L'Intense Eau de Parfum (in travel-friendly 50ml and 100ml) is an embodiment of strength with woody, spicy and elegant notes. Combining three ingredients and three accords, this captivating scent uses an artisanal process at the Orphin factory, where vanilla pods are cut into small pieces and steeped in alcohol until they take on a beautiful, warm amber hue. Leading the fragrance is the warm spiciness of hot pepper setting ablaze bewitching tonka bean. Grounding the scent is smoky notes intertwined with vanilla tincture to give this scent an unmistakable signature.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires L'Instant Magic Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Journeying into the unknown need not be encompassed with fear, instead indulge yourself in the Les Légendaires L'Instant Magic Eau de Parfum to invoke excitement and otherworldly thrills. Become enthralled by this perfume's all-consuming, ethereal nature, designed to teleport your mind, body and soul to a far away dream world. Identifiable from the first spritz, this delicately light fragrance oozes with notes of soft rose and velvety white musk to create a memorable traill of aromatic fantasy. Lingering on your skin with a sensual floral-meets-wood emulsion, brace yourself for head-turning compliments demanding to know the details of your heavenly- scent perfume...

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Hubert 50ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. The Hubert thrives in its masculinity, packing a powerful olfactory punch with aromatic geranium and minty green leaves. Described by SISLEY-PARIS as a ‘masculine rose’, L’eau Rêvée d’Hubert opens with a breath of peppermint, shiso and bucchu leaves before revealing its geranium heart, combined with earthy papyrus and cedarwood. It’s rounded off with woody notes of ambroxan, oakmoss and patchouli. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: HUDA BEAUTY Easy Bake Fragrance Duo Kit (Worth £96)
listings.description: Meet the Huda Beauty Easy Bake Fragrance Duo Kit — a bold, floral and gourmand scent featured in two sizes. This fragrance takes inspiration from the brand's iconic Easy Bake Loose Powder's scent. Opening with juicy wild cherry, it deepens into a seductive blend of white florals layered with warm cinnamon bark and creamy caramel milk, culminating in a luscious vanilla bourbon base. This intensified fragrance leaves an addictive, all-day trail that's impossible to ignore. Perfect for gifting, this duo is suited for every moment. Contents: Easy Bake Intense EDP (50ml) Easy Bake Intense EDP (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Cherrysia Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to take inspiration from nature to create an ode to its unique wonder, the Aqua Allegoria collection aims to inspire you to act for change. Guerlain's Aqua Allegoria Flora Cherrysia Eau de Toilette Refill (200ml) conjures up visions of the blooming cherry trees all over Japan, transporting your senses and capturing the delicate aroma of the iconic cherry blossom. An accord of fruity nashi pear and watermelon spotlights the fresh scent of cherry blossom, melding beautifully with essence of bergamot and powdery violet to create a truly intoxicating fragrance. Designed to top up your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle, you can use this with your fragrance and enjoy your scent for even longer.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa fragrance is described as a dancing rose by the brand. According to the brand's Master Perfumer, Thierry Wasser, the Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa is "a dancing rose". Combining its blooming namesake with a heart of fruity raspberry, blackcurrant and lychee accents, it's finished with a creamy, powdery and musky bed of sandalwood. This delicate scent is formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Be sure to keep this pretty (and refillable) fragrance pride of place on your vanity. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: A celebration of the power of nature and the vibrancy of a rainbow bouquet, the Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette (75ml) is a scent for floral fragrance lovers everywhere. Subtle centifolia roses from Grasse in France (considered the world's capital of perfume) blend with powdery, sweet violet, together with a true-to-nature tuberose heart. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon in California known as a superbloom (when desert flowers spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall), this delicate floral will dance across your wrists and have *everyone* asking what you're wearing...

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Mandarine Basilic Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to take inspiration from nature to create an ode to its unique wonder, the Aqua Allegoria Forte collection celebrates the beauty of nature with sheer intensity inspired by raw ingredients and notes. Guerlain's mandarin-scented eau de parfum transports you to the sight of the mandarine basilic forte, a lively, tangy citrus soaking in the sunlight. The exquisite Italian fruit is paired with delicious vanilla tincture and warming sandalwood to create a truly lively and uplifting fragrance with notes of basil completing this Italian-inspired scent. A fragrance that's designed to last, once you've finished your first love affair with this fresh fragrance, you can top up your refillable and recyclable bottle time and time again.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau de Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Guerlain's romantic fragrance is inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means ""temple of love"" in Sanskrit. This mythic eau de toilette is brimming with notes of bergamot, iris and vanilla. As for the bottle? It dates back to 1925 when designer Raymond Guerlain won first prize at the Paris Decorative Arts Exhibition. Its curves were inspired by the basins of the famous Shalimar gardens. The fan stopper with its sapphire transparency recalls the garden's eternally gushing water. In other words, it's a true objet d'art for your vanity.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Nahema Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Enigmatic, captivating and alluring to its core, the Les Légendaires Nahema Eau de Parfum inspires a seductive, fruity-floral emulsion that lingers on your skin. Perfectly curated over the years, this spellbinding fragrance oozes with rose-powered freshness wrapped in hyacinth and passion fruit. Sparking intrigue with its initial, love-at-first-scent aroma, this all-consuming perfume engulfs your senses with its moreish peach accords which settle into a deep, woody base thanks to patchouli and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum strikes the ultimate balance of floral and woody notes. Think sophistication meets strength. This evocative scent blends the spicy freshness of rosewood with the delicacy of rose and intensity of patchouli to create a finish that's utterly addictive. It's formulated with more than 90% natural origin ingredients, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The pretty pink bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity, and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design.
