listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: This bold and modern fragrance is based on the original Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum, the Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum (100ml) comes enhanced with a pear accord for a fruity twist. Each Mon Guerlain creation expresses an authentic concentration of emotion and know-how, creating scents designed with a base of just four (exceptional!) raw ingredients: lavender, jasmine, vanilla and sandalwood. The Sparkling Bouquet addition? A pear accord for a joyful opening. Think fruity, sun-kissed and fresh.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Chant D'Arômes Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Illustrating a tale of young love, the Les Légendaires Chant d'Arômes Eau de Toilette is bursting with sweet, seductive notes of honeysuckle dancing along a bed grounded by sandalwood. Housed in an iconic bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is sensual yet timeless. The scent opens with a floral hint of honeysuckle before blossoming into notes of gardenia, jasmine and ylang-ylang that mellow down into vanilla and sandalwood. A soft, charming fragrance that dances on the senses and burns with the embers of romance, this scent will evoke your fondest memories of first love or reignite your current flame.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires L'Initial Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by the thrill of entering a new chapter in life, the Les Légendaires L'Initial Eau de Parfum is bursting with floral notes of rose and iris merging into an exciting and luminous olfactory palette. Housed in an iconic glass bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is innocent yet daring. The scent opens with fresh citrus zest and a shower of jasmine petals, then blossoms into smooth vanilla topped with caramel and paired with delicately sweet tonka bean. All of these scents are completed with a misty cloud of white musk, finishing off the way this fragrance exemplifies the powers of innocence and diving headfirst into adventure.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Extrême Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain's L'Homme Idéal Extrême Eau de Parfum (100ml) is a woody aroma that's extremely addictive. What makes up this olfactory signature? Almond, the seal of the l'Homme Idéal collection, is accompanied at the top by the effervescence of bergamot mixed with pink pepper. In the heart, cinnamon and plum notes escort the heliotrope, a floral note with elegant almond accents. Finally, the charm of a woody patchouli and cedar is adorned with tobacco and an intense leather note.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette transports you to a warm Andalusian garden. If you love pomegranate, you'll love this fruity scent. "Granada Salvia is the surprising encounter between mouth-watering pomegranate and fresh sage," says Guerlain's Perfumer, Delphine Jelk. This delectable scent is bursting with sweet and fruity notes of the crimson fruit, amidst blackcurrant, cypress, lemon and bergamot. It's imbued with a twist of sage before landing on a sensual white musk, moss and patchouli base. As with all of the brand's fragrances, it's formulated with more than 90% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The pretty pink bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity, and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Vétiver Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the roots of vetiver, Guerlain's Vétiver Le Parfum (100ml) transports the senses to an undisturbed forest at sunrise. A reinterpretation of the iconic Vétiver Fragrance, this intoxicating scent opens with an aromatic blend of juniper berries, coriander and liquorice, before revealing a heart brimming with nutmeg and pepper. All this then gives way to smoky base of vetiver, tobacco and tonka bean for a sensual, earthy finish. Presented in a decadent bottle, this luxury perfume is stamped with a darker green label to reflect the intensity of the seductive fragrance...

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette Refill evokes the feeling of walking barefoot through freshly cut grass. Dreamy! Discover Herba Fresca: it's brimming with notes of fresh herbs sparkling with dew and springtime flowers, energised by a bunch of spearmint leaves and connected by a green tea accord. Thierry Wasser, Guerlain's Master Perfumer, describes it as "a tonic and refreshing country walk through grass glistening with dew". It's formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Don't be surprised if it becomes your new signature scent, just be sure to stock up on this refill. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Neroli Vetiver fragrance is essentially a love letter to Italy... Just one spritz and you'll be hooked. "Nerolia Vetiver is, first and foremost, an infatuation with Calabrian Neroli. It is the love of Italy, its landscapes and its art of living. It's la dolce vita!" says Guerlain Perfumer Delphine Jelk. This olfactory signature combines the floral radiance of its namesake, accentuated by vetiver and refreshing basil, and finally fused with a delicious fig accord. It's formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Keep it pride of place on your vanity in a bottle you can refill time and time again. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Champs-Elysées Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by a chance encounter on the Champs Élysées, the Les Légendaires Champs-Elysées Eau de Parfum from Guerlain celebrates the scent of spirited mimosa infused with rose notes and woody accents. Housed in an iconic, avant-garde glass bottle, this evocative fragrance is intense yet delicately balanced. The scent opens with blackcurrent berries and almond wood to capture the senses before blossoming into notes of hibiscus and mimosa flowers. Just a spritz of this scent will transport you to the French location and dare you to live life with buoyancy and spontaneity.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Gris Charnel Extrait de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: As silvery moonlight refracts and glitters across the Seine, BDK Parfums’ Gris Charnel Extrait Eau de Parfum (100ml) deepens Paris’ cool, magnetic sensuality. Near misses, stolen glances, quick kisses — as twilight falls in shades of grey, the city plays cupid with a knowing wink. Vibrant cardamom and delicate fig draw you in, enhanced by the mysterious depth of black tea, before giving way to Moroccan iris, cistus and bourbon vetiver. Beneath it all, sandalwood and tonka bean are enriched by earthy patchouli. More opulent, yet every bit as intimate as the original, Gris Charnel sees Paris’ darker undertones — its shadows, its contrasts, the secrets made in the midnight hours.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Gris Charnel Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: As silvery moonlight refracts and glitters across the Seine, BDK Parfums’ Gris Charnel Eau de Parfum (100ml) captures Paris’ cool, magnetic sensuality. Near misses, stolen glances, quick kisses — as twilight falls in shades of grey, the city plays cupid with a knowing wink. Fig and cardamom draw you in, giving way to smooth sandalwood and bourbon vetiver, softened by iris and warmed by tonka bean. Mysterious yet intimate, Gris Charnel sees Paris’ darker undertones — its shadows, its contrasts, the secrets made in the midnight hours.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Bouquet de Hongrie Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: At the heart of BDK Parfums’ Bouquet de Hongrie Eau de Parfum (100ml) is Edith Benedek, founder David Benedek’s beloved grandmother, whose discerning eye introduced Paris to some of the world’s most prestigious perfumes. A bouquet of the finest florals arranged in her honour, a romantic opening of pear, blackcurrant and strawberry entwine around a floral heart of Turkish rose and sensual jasmine. It’s then anchored in a warm, lingering base of musk, cedar and fiery amber. Like a portrait of elegance, poise and ambition — this scent is timeless, evoking the cold fall of jewels, silk gloves, light-scattered hallways and the first promise of spring in the Jardin du Palais-Royal.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Pas ce Soir Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: As twilight falls and rain-soaked streets shimmer, Paris slips into shades of indigo blue — BDK Parfums’ Pas Ce Soir Eau de Parfum (100ml) evokes a night of intrigue, allure and unexpected encounters. A burst of juicy mandarin and spicy ginger draws you in, its warmth contrasted by the soft, heady sensuality of jasmine absolute and orange blossom. Beneath it all, patchouli and amber woods anchor the scent in textured, woody depth. Equal parts mysterious and mischievous, Pas Ce Soir is Paris after dark — stiletto heels clicking across cobbled streets, figures shifting between shadows, invitations left unanswered.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Mandarine Basilic Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Run out of your signature scent? In one simple step, top up your precious Aqua Allegoria scent with this 200ml refill that works with both the 75ml and 100ml versions. Once that's done, continue to enjoy this celebration of the sun-drenched mandarin. Guerlain's mandarin-scented eau de parfum transports you to the sight of the mandarine basilic forte, a lively, tangy citrus soaking in the sunlight. The exquisite Italian fruit is paired with delicious vanilla tincture and warming sandalwood to create a truly lively and uplifting fragrance with notes of basil completing this Italian-inspired scent. A fragrance that's designed to last, once you've finished your first love affair with this fresh fragrance, you can top up your refillable and recyclable bottle time and time again.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Pas ce Soir Extrait de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: As twilight falls and rain-soaked streets shimmer, Paris slips into shades of indigo blue — BDK Parfums’ Pas Ce Soir Extrait Eau de Parfum (100ml) evokes a night of intrigue, allure and unexpected encounters. A burst of tangerine, ginger and spicy black pepper draws you in, its warmth softened by cocoa and the juicy sweetness of pear. At its heart, Moroccan jasmine, orange blossom and quince chutney unfold. Beneath it all, Indonesian patchouli and vanilla bring power and depth. Equal parts mysterious and mischievous, Pas Ce Soir is Paris after dark — stiletto heels clicking across cobbled streets, figures shifting between shadows, invitations left unanswered.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Can't Stop Loving You Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: We love love — who doesn’t?! — and nothing says it more than the Can’t stop loving You fragrance by Kilian. From pleasure-filled gourmand notes to intense earthiness and intoxicating florals, this compelling scent encapsulates the multi-faceted nature of the all-too-powerful love . A new addition to the narcotics olfactory family, this scent is led by orange blossom, a symbol of eternal love, and parasidone takes its side with an ethereal jasmine quality that conjures up images of paradise. At its heart is honey hailing from Provence, adding a deliciously sweet touch. A helping of vanilla absolute from Madagascar doubles up the gourmand factor to increase the pleasure, while oak moss helps ground the scent with an earthy quality. Wrapping up the fragrance in a veil of sensuality and endless mystery is incense extract from Somalia. Whether you’re gifting a special someone this memorable perfume for V-Day or you can’t stop loving yourself and just have to get this, we promise you won’t regret it.

listings.rawTitle: Kismet Olfactive Wedding In Oaxaca 50ml
listings.description: Kismet Olfactive's Wedding in Oaxaca (50ml) is a lively, woody-fresh fragrance that mingles creamy coconut milk and florals with a soft, grounding trail. Inspired by a celebration filled with music, dancing and the warmth of togetherness, this playful Eau de Toilette brings a festive spirit to fragrance. Pink pepper and ginger add a bright, gently spicy opening, softened by the creamy sweetness of coconut milk. At the heart, geranium, gardenia and violet leaves create a fresh, green floral accord. Osmanthus, musk and sandalwood then settle into a smooth, comforting dry-down that lingers close to the skin. Lively yet tender, it feels like a joyful moment captured in scent - made for days when you want to carry a little celebration with you.

listings.rawTitle: Kismet Olfactive The Poet 50ml
listings.description: Kismet Olfactive's The Poet (50ml) is a polished amber-woody fragrance, balancing luminous grapefruit and Casablanca lily with incense, woods and warm tonka. Quietly assured and rich in character, Kismet Olfactive's The Poet brings together floral, resinous and woody notes in a composition that feels both grounded and alluring. Grapefruit and ambrox open with a bright, modern edge before the heart reveals Casablanca lily, soft ambrette musk and the smoky warmth of frankincense. As the scent settles, sandalwood, patchouli and tonka bean create a smooth, gently sweet trail with an elegant depth. Mysterious without feeling heavy, this is a considered choice for evenings or whenever you want a fragrance with presence and polish. Handcrafted in New York, it leaves a warm impression that lingers close to the skin.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Samsara Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: A fragrant trail like no other, the Les Légendaires Samsara Eau de Parfum encourages you to lean on your intuition and follow your senses onto a path paved with harmony, love and peace. Translating to "eternal rebirth" in Sanskrit, this notable scent serves as a reminder of the agape love that resides within you. Bursting with prevalent jasmine notes, ylang-ylang florals that become melded together with the comforting warmth of sandalwood, iris, tonka bean and vanilla, this radiance composition lingers on your skin with envy-inducing allure.

listings.rawTitle: Kismet Olfactive Nostalgia (A Sonnet For Grasse) 50ml
listings.description: A love song to Grasse, where Kismet founder Shabnam Tavakol studied perfumery, Nostalgia (A Sonnet For Grasse) (50ml) is composed of 14 raw materials, a fragrant nod to the sonnet's 14 lines. Its opening of anise brings a distinctive herbal lift, before the heart reveals tonka bean and rose de mai, evoking the flower-filled hillsides that helped make Grasse the perfume capital of the world. In the dry-down, leather, suede and nagarmotha create a deep, smoky finish with a softly musky edge. Bold, floral, spicy and unmistakably expressive, this Eau de Toilette is a captivating scent for anyone drawn to fragrances with a story to tell.

listings.rawTitle: Kismet Olfactive Nymphéas 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by Monet's water lilies, Kismet Olfactive's Nymphéas (50ml) is a fresh floral fragrance that captures the shifting light and stillness of a garden pond. The composition opens with the cool impression of pond water, then reveals a delicate floral heart of maté, lily of the valley and lotus. Beneath these airy notes, vetiver and oakmoss bring an earthy, green finish that grounds the fragrance without dimming its gentle luminosity. It evokes a familiar landscape seen in a new light; soft, enchanting and quietly uplifting. Wear this floral-fresh Eau de Toilette when you want a little sunshine and calm, whatever the season.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Carmen Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover the captivating allure of Trudon Carmen Parfum (100ml) a sophisticated scent that elevates the house’s legendary legacy into an intimate, skin-focused expression. Bright top notes of bergamot, grapefruit and rum give way to a rich heart of leather, tobacco, oak and clove, exuding warmth and depth. Anchored by a base of patchouli, labdanum, ambroxan and moss, this fragrance unfolds with a complex, textured evolution on the skin. Crafted by Émilie Bouge at 15% concentration, this scent offers remarkable longevity and a bold, refined signature, an olfactory masterpiece of modern elegance and timeless character.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Extra Parfum Travel Spray 15ml
listings.description: Balenciaga Extra Parfum (15ml) is a rich, golden elixir that ignites the senses with an electric, effervescent energy. Opening with pink pepper and heated black pepper oil, its vibrant, spice-led profile is softened by an everlasting flower accord that radiates crackling warmth intertwined with hints of leather. Both flamboyant and dynamic, it evokes a world where myth meets modernity. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, it threads together the iconic fashion house’s past and present.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barénia Pleine Fleur Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Experience striking elegance with Hermès' Barénia Pleine Fleur Eau de Parfum (30ml), a woody and lightly floral scent. Belonging to the chypre fragrance family, it opens with a burst of fresh white lily and radiant orange blossom. It then deepens into a base of rich patchouli and sweet miracle berry, creating gentle intensity that lingers on your skin long after you've spritzed. This luminous, elegant aroma comes in an equally sophisticated bottle (inspired by some of the house's most famous fine jewellery), balancing elliptical glass curves with a stud-adorned metal plate. Plus, it's refillable, so you'll never be without your new signature scent again...

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Scent Layering Set (Worth £42.00)
listings.description: Wrapped and ready to gift, the Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Scent Layering Set is a daily fragrance routine in the brand’s signature marine blend. Beginning in the bath (or shower), this trio cleanses, hydrates and scents with its bracing blue cypress, cardamom and invigorating sea spray-inspired notes. Fresh, punchy and perfect for a loved one, it arrives in a luxury black box topped with a contrast ribbon. Contents: Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Bath & Shower Gel (100ml) Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Body Lotion (100ml)

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Embark on a new journey with the Chloe Nomade Eau de Parfum (75ml), a floral woody, melange that summons your adventurous side. Opening with ripened notes of Mirabelle plum, this scent awakens the senses with a juicy zest. At its heart, a bouquet of radiant freesia illuminates the aroma with a lofral sweetness. An earthy base of oak moss conjures vision of the natural world, grounding the scent with a comforting finish.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by Chloé founder Gaby Aghion's birthplace, Nomade Lumière d'Égypte (30ml) evokes a journey along the Nile where blue lotus blooms. Blue lotus opens the scent, followed by soft jasmine, while pink berry and elemi add a richness and warmth. A base of kyphi accord with cinnamon, sandalwood and myrrh gives depth for a long-lasting olfactive trail. Encased in the Nomade bottle with golden accents and a dusky blue knot, the scent carries a light, aquatic floralcy.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier Des Fleurs Plage Du Figuier Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the sun-drenched elegance of the Mediterranean with Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Plage du Figuier Eau de Parfum (150ml) a luminous ode to coastal bliss. Inspired by the brand founder's love for Ramatuelle, perfumer Ane Ayo unveils a warm, fleshy fig accentuated by radiant orange blossom. Bright top notes of bergamot and eucalyptus evoke the invigorating sea breeze, while a heart of black fig and floral accords deepen the scent's pulpy richness. Base notes of cedarwood, fir balsam and ambrox add warmth and sensuality, evoking sun-warmed sand and coastal landscapes. Housed in a signature undulating glass bottle with a sand-coloured cap, it captures effortless Mediterranean elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor Sage'S Rose Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: A smoky, sumptuous take on the eternal rose, TSU LANGE YOR’s Sage’s Rose Eau de Parfum (10ml) is soft yet sensual, luminous yet dark. A magnetic opening leads with warm sugar and resinous myrrh, before entwining around a heart of leafy green vetiver, Egyptian geranium and hazy poppies. A nuanced scent, fresh flowers catch the light; beneath them, patchouli deepens into shadow. Named in tribute to Troye Sivan’s sister — Sage’s Rose is a world of pink satin, wind-swept hair, vintage magazines and Parisian sunlight.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor Pool Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Scintillating with the joy of carefree abandon, TSU LANGE YOR’s Pool Eau de Parfum (10ml) is an ode to warm, heady days that stretch into night. An effervescent opening, it’s layered with notes of fresh cucumber, lychee and Italian bergamot, before sailing into a crisp heart of green tomato leaf and crushed coriander. Beneath it, spicy ginger, musk and tangy pepper create a bright, textured dry down. A postcard from warmer climes; think of it as salt on skin, cold raspberries, bare feet, loose plans and the last light of day.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor Pool Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Scintillating with the joy of carefree abandon, TSU LANGE YOR’s Pool Eau de Parfum (50ml) is an ode to warm, heady days that stretch into night. An effervescent opening, it’s layered with notes of fresh cucumber, lychee and Italian bergamot, before sailing into a crisp heart of green tomato leaf and crushed coriander. Beneath it, spicy ginger, musk and tangy pepper create a bright, textured dry down. A postcard from warmer climes; think of it as salt on skin, cold raspberries, bare feet, loose plans and the last light of day.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor Sala Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A fresh, verdant affair — TSU LANGE YOR’s SALA Eau de Parfum (50ml) celebrates the beauty of new beginnings. Named for co-founder Troye Sivan’s newborn nephew, Sala, this lush scent opens with earthy galbanum and coriander seed before unfolding into a heart of orchid and vetiver. At its base, ambrox and musk create a deep, skin-close finish — creamy, woody and intimate. Rooted in the promise of renewal, SALA is a storybook of firsts: early morning dew, spring rain, gathered wildflowers and the anticipation of what’s to come.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor Luca Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Designed as an amplification of your individuality, TSU LANGE YOR’s Luca Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a stirring, woody scent. Opening with bergamot, citrusy elemi and spicy black pepper, it settles into an earthy heart of moss, cedarwood and clary sage. Beneath it, ambrox, sandalwood and musk create a deep, skin-close finish — creamy, woody and intimate. Dreamed up in the aftermath of a breakup, Luca captures the duality of loss and the possibility of renewal: warm morning light, crisp sheets, heavy denim and neon-lit nights.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor By Your Side Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: A smoky, intimate scent, TSU LANGE YOR’s By Your Side Eau de Parfum (10ml) lingers like the memory of a first love. An aromatic opening of pink pepper and cardamom cuts a sharp edge, softened by creamy cedarwood. Beneath it, rich leather, frankincense and smoke create a warm, enveloping heart, before settling into a grounded base of wolfwood, cypriol and upcycled cedarwood. It's a scent for staying close; evoking the delicate romanticism of borrowed jackets, tangled bodies, fluttering candlelight and pearly morning mist.

listings.rawTitle: Tsu Lange Yor Luca Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Designed as an amplification of your individuality, TSU LANGE YOR’s Luca Eau de Parfum (10ml) is a stirring, woody scent. Opening with bergamot, citrusy elemi and spicy black pepper, it settles into an earthy heart of moss, cedarwood and clary sage. Beneath it, ambrox, sandalwood and musk create a deep, skin-close finish — creamy, woody and intimate. Dreamed up in the aftermath of a breakup, Luca captures the duality of loss and the possibility of renewal: warm morning light, crisp sheets, heavy denim and neon-lit nights.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Elixir des Merveilles Eau de Parfum Natural Spray 100ml
listings.description: Hermès Elixir des Merveilles Eau de Parfum (100ml) boasts a woody aroma that's evocative of the awe-inspiring star it takes its name from. At the heart of this aromatic blend sits sweet-but-citrussy notes of candied orange, which develops into warm and sensual layers of deep patchouli and benzoin, part of the amber fragrance family. Its sleek, round bottle resembles a magnifying glass, encouraging your imagination to run wild with each spritz. If you're looking to take your senses on a journey of discovery, we think this is a pretty good place to start...

listings.rawTitle: The Nue Co. Forest Lungs Mood-Balancing Fragrance 50ml
listings.description: While we might like to pack our bags and live a reclusive life in the mountains, it's not all that feasible; even taking a trip feels near-impossible in the current climate. That's where The Nue Co.'s Forest Lungs fragrance steps in. Harnessing olfactory chemistry and patented technology, this gender-neutral, anti-stress fragrance supplement brings the outside in, delivering the healing effects of nature at a moment's notice. Created by world-renowned perfumer Guillaume Flavigny, recipient of the Prix International du Jeune Parfumeur Cr©ateur, this sensory supplement counters the effects of everyday stress. This innovative fragrance replicates the molecular compounds produced by trees (read: phytoncides) that are credited for the positive health benefits associated with forest bathing, namely the balancing of stress levels and boosting the parasympathetic (rest) nervous system. As for the scent itself, expect a woody and smoky profile of vetiver, cedarwood, benzoin and pine, punctuated with clean resin and tart citrus notes. In research conducted by The Nue Co., 96% of participants felt less stressed within 30 minutes of using Forest Lungs and 91% felt their anxiety levels were reduced after using it for thirty days. Now available in the original (50ml) and a mini (10ml) vial, you can keep a spray at home and slip one in your everyday bag.

listings.rawTitle: Kismet Olfactive Tuberose Tantra 50ml
listings.description: Kismet Olfactive's Tuberose Tantra (50ml) is a sensual floral-woody fragrance that builds from spicy ginger and clove to narcotic white florals and a rich, lingering base. Designed to unfold slowly, this evocative Eau de Toilette takes its time: first a spark of clove and ginger root, then a lush floral heart of tuberose and jasmine. The dry-down is deep and enveloping, as patchouli meets creamy sandalwood and smooth cashmeran. The result is a confident, playful scent with a warm, skin-close finish and an unmistakably sensual mood. Wear it when you want your fragrance to feel like part of the occasion, not just the finishing touch. Handcrafted in New York, it's a striking choice for lovers of expressive florals with a softly woody edge.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Heure Bleue - Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Evoking the deep blue of the sky at dusk, Geurlin's L'Heure Bleue Eau de Parfum Refill (200ml) is a fresh, floral fragrance. This ambery scent opens with fresh notes of an ozonic accord, sweet pear and radiant neroli, before unfolding into an elegant heart of blooming iris, marshmallow accord and musky jasmine. It deepens into a rich base of vanilla, ambroxan and musk, leaving a powerful yet intimate trail. Encased in the iconic inverted heart bottle - a tribute to the original 1912 L'Heure Bleue design, created to be refilled and stand the test of time.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Re-Charge Black Pepper Aroma Reeds Refill 150ml
listings.description: Fill the air with comforting notes using the Molton Brown Re-Charge Black Pepper Aroma Reeds Refill (150ml), a herbaceous home fragrance for your living space. The scent opens with a burst of black pepper, lemon, and ginger, creating an invigorating and vibrant atmosphere. As it settles, aromatic coriander and basil add a herbaceous depth, while earthy vetiver, oakmoss, and rich ambergris linger in the air for a grounded, sensual finish.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Drunk Lovers Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Characterised by a whirlwind of warmth and electric energy, let BORNTOSTANDOUT's Drunk Lovers Eau De Parfum (50ml) intoxicate the senses with its lust-fuelled fragrance. Rich and liquor-like, this scent swirls vibrant citrus fruits with heady spices, pulsing in an exciting infusion topped by animalic musk. Equal parts playful and seductive, think delicious nuances of grapefruit and bergamot, dancing amongst velvety brandy, cinnamon and sandalwood in an unexpected olfactive union. Expertly intertwined for long-lasting intensity, this perfume calls upon all thrill seekers to indulge in the heat of the moment.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Milk- Personal 100ml
listings.description: Embrace warm, sweet notes of Commodity's Milk- Personal (100ml), a fragrance that feels like a comforting hug. Perfect for those who want to savour their scent and hold it close, this light rendition blends delicate accents of warm marshmallow with toasted sesame notes. Traces of mahogany wood and tonka bean begin to pull through after a few minutes, striking the just-right balance between soft and inviting. Finally, at the base you are met with creamy, woody accords of white cedar and comforting skin musk.

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Crème Brûlante 30ml
listings.description: Feel the heat rising with Fascent CRÈME BRÛLANTE Eau de Parfum (30ml). This addictive scent bottles the irresistible moment a warm oven is opened, filling the air with the golden, rising warmth of freshly baked pastries. Starting with a creamy duo of rich vanilla and almond balm, it takes you on a journey of indulgence, enhanced with a splash of rum to add sweetness. Base notes of golden amber and comforting benzoin deepen the warmth of this scent, inviting you to savour the smell of freshly baked pastries.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Step into a dreamy haze of sweetness with the Juliette Has a Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum (100ml), a soft, enveloping gourmand fragrance that captures the nostalgic charm of cotton candy and powdered skin. This delicate scent opens with playful notes of marshmallow and cotton candy, evoking childhood memories of pure innocence and comfort. The heart reveals sugared almond and orange blossom, adding a subtle floral warmth, while the base of tonka bean, ambroxan and powdery musk creates a smooth, sensual finish that lingers long after. Designed for those who love a refined yet cozy scent, it’s an airy cloud of sweetness and serenity, perfect for embracing a moment of quiet indulgence. Its soft, powdery aura makes every day feel like a gentle, fragrant dream.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Shower Oil
listings.description: An indulgent bathroom experience, Le Labo's Shower Oil (250ml) is a great way to streamline your wake-up regime. Boasting a skin-nourishing cocktail of moisturising coconut, hydrating argan and soothing sunflower oils, this creamy body wash gently (but thoroughly) cleanses your limbs. Transforming from oil to an opulent milk, it helps to boost bounce and enhance elasticity, keeping your skin feeling smooth, soft and supple. Plus, it's infused with sparkling mandarin layered with floral notes of geranium that will keep you freshly scented long after rinsing.

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Red Flag 30ml
listings.description: A fragrance of seduction, push beauty's boundaries with Fascent RED FLAG Eau de Parfum (30ml). This striking fragrance settles into the skin with a spark of fresh ginger and warm cardamom. At its heart is dark iris entwined with smoky frankincense, creating a sophisticated, velvety finish. An addictive base is revealed with notes Palo Santo wood and creamy tonka bean. Don't even try to resist the temptation of this all-alluring scent.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Vanilla Haze Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gourmand vanilla all grown up, Fugazzi's Vanilla Haze Extrait de Parfum (50ml) blends seductively refined amber scents. Kicking off with a citrus twist of lemon, wrapped in a creamy coconut milk and toasted hazelnut embrace, this irresistible EDP is for those who crave a little more indulgence. Warming the fragrance with soft woody nuances is a blend of cashmeran, complemented by a drizzle of caramel, swirled in rich, bourbon-infused vanilla. Musky skin and saffron notes close this sumptuous trail, leaning into a more luxurious finish.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Beetroot Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Taking inspiration from the vibrant vegetable patch, Jo Malone London invites you to find joy in the small things with the Scarlet Beetroot Cologne (30ml). Centred around an earthy, authentic beetroot accord, topped with a dash of fruity blackcurrant, this playful scent celebrates the colourful charm of nature. Grounded by a woody patchouli note, it lingers on the skin with luminous longevity, uplifting the senses with each and every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum 8ml
listings.description: Feel the warmth of first light with NEST New York’s Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum (8ml). Like wrapping yourself in the finest cashmere, this warm and spicy scent takes you on a sensory escape. It opens with a burst of sweet cardamom, evoking that blissful first sip of a creamy, spiced latte. As it settles, a comforting heart of jasmine petals lends a subtle musk aroma before melting into a creamy base of rich coconut milk. Smooth, irresistible and cosy, it’s the go-to fragrance for quiet, slow-paced days.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Coastal Cypress and Sea Fennel Aroma Reeds 150ml Refill
listings.description: Filling the air with crisp yet cool, spicy and sophisticated notes, the Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Aroma Reeds diffuse a wave of sense-awakening freshness inspired by salt-sprayed collisions taking place far beyond the shore. Adventurous and invigorating, this ocean-drenched aroma transforms your living space into an uncharted getaway overlooking the horizon where the sun meets the sea.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Fig Porn Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fig Porn Eau De Parfum (50ml) invites you to lose yourself in the scent, and everything it stirs. Juicy fig and sun-warmed pear pull you in with soft, ripe sweetness before blurring into a bloom of rose and peony, grounded by a trace of smoky cedarwood. As it settles, amber, vanilla and sandalwood unfold in a slow, lingering burn that feels warm, intimate and quietly addictive, made to be worn close.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Weave a little magic into your everyday with the Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum (50ml). This deep and earthy fragrance inspires courage and creativity, ensuring you enchant everyone you meet. Feeling creative? Spark your imagination with this intense and bewitching scent designed to truly evoke a sense of magic. Grounded with patchouli and blended with deep (and rare) Moroccan orris absolute, this potent potion is further entwined with thorny rose, nutmeg, cinnamon and black pepper to add a little spice. As if that wasn't enough, this alluring fragrance wraps senses with illuminating frankincense and musk. It's sensual, empowering and mysterious, primed and ready to cast a spell on anyone you leave in your wake.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by The House of Creed's tailoring past and the early 20th century sketchbooks of Henry The House of Creed II, the Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum is brimming with luxurious and bold ingredients. Opening with vibrant bergamot, tart grapefruit, tangy pink pepper and herbaceous blackcurrant, this fragrance then blossoms into a floral heart of jasmine, soft rose and sweet violet. Signature notes of oud and benzoin adds depth while warm accords include vanilla and musk. It's so charming, we almost feel the need to curtsy before this regal creation...

listings.rawTitle: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by The House of Creed's tailoring past and the early 20th century sketchbooks of Henry The House of Creed II, the Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum is brimming with luxurious and bold ingredients. Opening with vibrant bergamot, tart grapefruit, tangy pink pepper and herbaceous blackcurrant, this fragrance then blossoms into a floral heart of jasmine, soft rose and sweet violet. Signature notes of oud and benzoin adds depth while warm accords include vanilla and musk. It's so charming, we almost feel the need to curtsy before this regal creation...

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Ready to meet your new signature scent? Cue Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau De Parfum Intense (50ml). Inspired by one's relationship with nature, this earthy fragrance was created by Christine Nagel, Hermès' perfumer, and combines fiery bergamot with burning wood, underpinned by the mineral notes of intense lava stone. What's more, this luxury scent deserves pride of place on your vanity thanks to its thoughtful design. At its base, the bottle rests on an 'H' leaving its imprint on the earth, while at the top the light is reflected by metal shoulders. Ready, set, spritz...

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum & Cream Scent Bundle (Worth £156.40)
listings.description: Unleash your mystical side with the Vyrao Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum & Hand Cream Bundle, a captivating duo designed to inspire courage, creativity and a touch of magic. The Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum is an enchanting, mysterious scent that weaves earthy patchouli, rare Moroccan orris, thorny rose and spicy notes of nutmeg, cinnamon and black pepper. Illuminated by frankincense and musk, it’s a deeply empowering fragrance that sparks imagination and confidence, perfect for those who dare to stand out. Paired with the nourishing Witchy Woo Hand Cream, this sensory-rich duo hydrates and softens skin with ceramides, hyaluronic acid and vitamin E, while the opulent scent transforms your routine into a ritual of empowerment and allure. Contents: Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum (50ml) Witchy Woo Hand Cream (75ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fenty Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Enjoy a warm embrace with floral yet spicy tones in Fenty Beauty's Fenty Eau de Parfum (30ml). Although Autumnal in appearance, this fragrance works for all the seasons. Taking you on an olfactive journey, it starts with a blend of comforting musk melded with luxurious Bulgarian rose absolute. It then bursts into a zesty mix of juicy tangerine, blueberry and patchouli. Balancing these bright accords, magnolia is added for a creamy, sweet twist that will result in endless compliments to the wearer. We're obsessed.

listings.rawTitle: Fascent I Fig You 30ml
listings.description: Breathe in crisp, fresh air with Fascent’s I FIG YOU Eau de Parfum (30ml). A sophisticated scent, it opens with a delicate blend of natural green tea and sage to ground you against the bustle of the world. As the fragrance settles, it transitions into comforting heart notes of fig leaf and carrot seeds, unveiling a uniquely green, milky aroma. At the base, experience the deeply calming properties of earthy vetiver and smoky cedarwood. Mist, breathe, and let nature take over.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Bal d'Afrique Absolu de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover a new level of olfactory richness with Byredo’s Absolut Bal D'Afrique (50ml), a captivating blend that elevates the original with a more gourmand, deeply indulgent profile. Opening with lively notes of bergamot, lemon and blackcurrant, the fragrance transitions into a heart of praline, violet and soft musks, creating a velvety, irresistible core. The base introduces earthy vetiver and cedarwood, enriched with warm black amber and rich praline for a lasting, luxurious finish. This reinterpretation strikes an intriguing balance between sparkling top notes and enveloping warmth, making it both bold and subtle.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Sensual and smoky, the Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum (30ml) is a woody fragrance pining to be in your scent drobe. At first, this perfume opens with a fruity, floral charm of plum, bergamot and Italian orange. It then blooms into a heart of spicy patchouli, soft rose and earthy cannabis for a woody touch. As for the base? This sensual fragrance is sweetened with vanilla, musk, dark chocolate and vetiver accords. It's a truly enchanting scent for all to enjoy.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Cristóbal Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The master of all haute couture, Cristóbal Parfum (100ml) celebrates the mind behind fashion’s most influential creations. Reflecting the duality of Cristóbal Balenciaga, the most treasured name of the House, this scent is crafted around the richness of oud oil — one of modern perfumery’s most precious ingredients. Rare Assafi oud essence is entwined with sensual patchouli and oakmoss, unfolding into a composition of shadow, warmth and depth. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, it threads together the fashion house’s past and present.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Violette 30 Eau De Parfum 15Ml
listings.description: The Le Labo Violette 30 Eau de Parfum (15ml) is an ode to the undefinable contrasts captured in a single, perfect flower. In the secret language of flowers, the violet has always stood for a paradoxical bouquet of meanings; from passion to innocence, strength to delicacy. This scent embraces that complexity, centering around the rare, shadow-seeking white violet to create a fragrance that is at once crystalline and untethered. Its verdant green floral heart is paired with the clean elegance of white tea notes, before settling into a grounding, woody base of cedarwood and a touch of guaiacwood. Familiar yet mysterious, it's a sophisticated study in contradiction, inviting you to embrace your own many multitudes.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Eucalyptus 20 (15ml)
listings.description: The Le Labo Eucalyptus 20 (15ml) eau de parfum is an ode to the notion of hope in a vast western desert. Just one spritz reveals the inspiration behind this scent: a sunbaked copper desert, vast stretches of sky and a lone eucalyptus tree that stands as a beacon of hope in an unforgiving landscape. Escape the heat with the cooling freshness of this evergreen, accented by rustic leather, woody cedar and sweet labdanum, creating an awakening, complex fragrance that is rounded by woody musk and smoky frankincense. Refresh and rebalance with eucalyptus, as the whispers of a long day in the desert linger.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Carrot Blossom Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Part of the limited-edition Veggies Collection, Jo Malone London's Carrot Blossom Cologne celebrates a freshly picked vegetable patch with subtly sweet and earthy notes. The fragrance blends carrot, orange flower and white musk to create an airy freshness. Housed in a vibrant carrot-orange bottle, the cologne conjures British harvest with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Beach Blossom Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Setting the scene for sun-warmed skin and salt-kissed air, the Jo Malone London Beach Blossom Cologne (50ml) opens with a rush of coconut water and lime. Inspired by the shores of the Seychelles, this light cologne layers fresh citrus notes over a creamy heart that gently unfolds as it settles. A hint of tonka bean adds warmth, keeping the scent easy to wear. Reach for it when you want a fragrance that feels breezy and uplifting.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Velvety Butternut Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Part of the limited-edition Veggies Collection, Jo Malone London's Velvety Butternut Cologne blends warm, spicy notes with slightly nutty undertones for a woody gourmand scent. As if playfully plucked from the patch, butternut squash creates a smooth base, amplified by ginger, patchouli and tonka bean. Evoke British harvest time with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Lost Eden Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Step into a mystical garden of seduction with Maison Margiela's Replica Lost Eden (100ml) a captivating fragrance that unfolds around a forbidden fruit accord. This woody scent opens with juicy, candied red apple, delivering an irresistible burst of sweetness and tartness. The heart reveals velvety vanilla, adding warmth and softness, while a smoky oud accord grounds the fragrance with an enigmatic depth. Rich, contrasting and endlessly alluring, this scent balances gourmand sweetness with mysterious woody facets, leaving a trail that’s both unforgettable and seductive. Designed for those who crave a bold yet refined scent, it captures the essence of temptation and intrigue in a single bottle, perfect for making a statement that lingers.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: A celebration of the power of nature and the vibrancy of a rainbow bouquet, the Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette (125ml) is a scent for floral fragrance lovers everywhere. Subtle centifolia roses from Grasse in France (considered the world's capital of perfume) blend with powdery, sweet violet, together with a true-to-nature tuberose heart. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon in California known as a superbloom (when desert flowers spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall), this delicate floral will dance across your wrists and have *everyone* asking what you're wearing...

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI The Wedding Velvet Santal 35 50ml
listings.description: Anticipation, celebration and excitement all in one, Kayali's The Wedding Velvet Santal (50ml) is an ode to your biggest day and the purest form of affection, love. Conjured up by Kayali founders Mona Kattan and her husband Hassan, this refined fragrance is personal and warm, suave and sheer, in tribute to their own wedding day. It comes grounded with a balanced heart of powdery white musk, resin-y cedarwood and creamy, almost velvety sandalwood. A magnetic blend of sweet, floral jasmine and honeyed benzoin rounds off the formula, for a unique, captivating scent that casts an enveloping halo and long-lasting, lingering scentscape around you.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Lily Jasmine Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Breathe in the freshness of a floral bouquet with the Lily Jasmine Eau de Parfum (30ml) from fresh. This alluring, floral fragrance opens with lively notes of sparkling bergamot, soft lavender and pink pepper before blooming into accords of fresh clarysage, spring muguet and jasmine sambac at the heart. As for the base? It envelops the senses with a mingling of creamy cedarwood, crystal moss and warm amber. Spritz yourself all over and revel in the comforting aroma before embracing some new beginnings...

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather All Over Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Paying homage to TOM FORD's Texan roots, the Ombre Leather All Over Body Spray (150ml) combines warming spices with delicate florals. Lighter but just as tempting, spiced cardamom and jasmine sambac summons images of a sun-soaked desert in this sultry scent. At its core, black leather takes over the aroma, alongside heated amber and patchouli. Expertly designed with 360-spray technology, the spray delivers effortless application all over.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Vanilla Planifolia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Experience the floral freshness of Chloé's Atelier des Fleurs Vanilla Planifolia Eau de Parfum (50ml). Infused with delectable gourmands, the fragrance reveals luminous notes of the rare Vanilla planifolia orchid. The tempting aroma is layered with enticing spices and grounding woods to extend its sensual charm.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Insolence Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Getting straight to the heart of an uncompromising love characterised by a bold, sensual personality, the Les Légendaires Insolence Eau de Parfum is floral and fruity, seductive and sensual all at the same time. Housed in an iconic glass bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is sultry and daring. The scent dives headfirst into floral notes of violet accord with accents of iris, alongside soft notes of orange blossom. Telling the tale of a brazen love story with a protagonist of undeniable irresistibility at its centre, Insolence inspires its wearer to be confident, spontaneous and unabashedly yourself.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Filthy Musk Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A fragrance that flirts with your senses and leaves a lingering trail, BORNTOSTANDOUT Filthy Musk Eau De Parfum (50ml) dares you to embrace the raw allure of primal musk. This scent opens with an intoxicating blend of pineapple, honey, and animalic musk, instantly creating a magnetic tension. As it settles, spicy patchouli, nutmeg and jasmine add a sensual, exotic heart, while the base envelops you in a warm embrace of vanilla, caramel, tonka bean and lingering amber. Unapologetically bold, this fragrance is for the mavericks and misfits among us.

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Radical Softness 30ml
listings.description: Unlock raw, carnal energy with Fascent RADICAL SOFTNESS Eau de Parfum (30ml). This soft, yet fierce fragrance captures the thrill of the unexpected, opening with vibrant pink pepper and warming Ambrox, capturing the rush of a quickening pulse, the movement of two bodies entwining. As it develops, a base of velvety white musk and delicate cyclamen unfolds, clinging to the skin like a sweet, nostalgic memory.

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Discovery Set
listings.description: Discover your signature scent with the Fascent Discovery Set, a curated collection of eight mini fragrances designed to explore a spectrum of moods and nuances. Perfect for fragrance lovers eager to find their next signature or to indulge in a sensory journey across different olfactory worlds. From the sweet, fresh notes of Corn Star with pear and popcorn to the citrusy sparkle of L’Eau d’Or Dort and the herbaceous depth of I FIG YOU, each scent offers a unique story. Dive into floral, woody, gourmand and aromatic profiles with Radical Softness, Crème Brûlante and more. Compact yet captivating, this set is your passport to discovering a new signature or simply layering your mood for every moment. Contents: Corn Star (2ml) Crème Brûlante (2ml) I Fig You (2ml) L’Eau d’Or Dort (2ml) Milky No Way (2ml) Radial Softness (2ml) Red Flag (2ml) Sel à Vie (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Creed Iris Debonair Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Creed’s Iris Debonair Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an elegantly turned-out fragrance that mixes the precision of couture fashion with the fine art of French haute perfumery. Luminous bergamot, infused with absinthe leaves opens with intentional charm. Next, the finest lavender from Kent brings crisp, herbaceous clarity. Deeper in the palette, French iris pallida from Les Landes, grown over three years, casts magnetic shades of pale blue. Born of Creed’s outstanding Franco-British heritage, this elegant, self-assured Eau De Parfum is debonair in every sense.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Rose of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A gentle tribute to selflessness and compassion, the Rose of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum celebrates the nickname given to nurses by soldiers during World War One. Having saved thousands of lives, this olfactory reminder serves as a heartfelt thank you. Sweet top notes of pink pepper and Turkish rose petals tickle the senses alongside a vibrant heart of raspberry blossom and Turkish rose absolute. Delicately dancing atop a base of earthy papyrus and fresh white amber, each note perfectly harmonises with each other to deliver a subtly sweet, addictive scent. And, much like the nurses who tended to wounded soldiers, this charming fragrance acts as a comforting and soothing presence.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Rose of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A gentle tribute to selflessness and compassion, the Rose of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum celebrates the nickname given to nurses by soldiers during World War One. And, much like the nurses who tended to wounded soldiers, this charming fragrance acts as a comforting and soothing presence.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Lavande Poivre Noir Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Formerly known as L'Occitan, the L'OCCITANE Lavande Poivre Noir Eau de Toilette (50ml) is a sophisticated scent, which balances the soothing freshness of French lavender with the spicy depth of black pepper for a refined signature fragrance. Crafted with natural lavender essential oil, it opens with aromatic, herbaceous notes before warming into a woody, subtly smoky base. The result is an effortlessly elegant aura that feels timeless yet modern.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Ready to meet your new signature scent? Cue Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette (50ml). Inspired by one's relationship with nature, this earthy fragrance was created by Christine Nagel, Hermès' perfumer, and combines the strength of cedar and the radiance of grapefruit with a vibrant touch of flint. What's more, this luxury scent deserves pride of place on your vanity thanks to its thoughtful design. At its base, the bottle rests on an 'H' leaving its imprint on the earth, while at the top the light is reflected by metal shoulders. Ready, set, spritz...

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the power of the earth, the Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver Eau de Parfum (50ml) evokes notes of musk and greenery. Created by Christine Nagel, Hermès' perfumer, this warm, intense fragrance expresses the depth of vetiver combined with the liveliness of green bergamot and spicy Sichuan pepper. As for the decadent bottle? This luxury scent deserves pride of place on your vanity thanks to its thoughtful design. At its base, the bottle rests on an 'H' in a deeper shade of orange while the original cap then takes on a warm brown hue of leather tanned in the sun. We think you've just discovered your new signature scent...

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Milk+ Bold 100ml
listings.description: Make an entrance with Commodity's Milk+ Bold (100ml), a fragrance that feels like a comforting hug, this ready-to-spritz treat is designed to linger on the skin. Perfect for those who have a flare for the dramatics, this intensive rendition blends accents of warm marshmallow with toasted sesame notes. Traces of mahogany wood and tonka bean begin to pull through after a few minutes, striking the just-right balance between soft and inviting. Finally, at the base you are met with accords of sweet and warm amber alongside firewood, a note reminiscent of the cozy crackling of a fireplace. Get ready to answer, "what are you wearing?" a thousand times.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Vanilla Haze Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fugazzi Fragrances' Vanilla Haze (50ml) is an enveloping scent that oozes attitude and confidence. The unique fragrance starts with hits of mandarin at the top, spiked by coconut milk, almond and hazelnut, before giving way to a deliciously creamy core. The middle is sweetened with tenderly spiced vanilla pod and tonka bean and finished with a dash of floral jasmine. The grand finale? An indulgent fusion of sticky crème brûlée, powdery white amber and woody musk. Spritz it on for when you want to let personality seep through and remain truly unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Mojave Ghost Absolu de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Byredo’s Mojave Ghost Absolu de Parfum (100ml) is an intensified riff on the classic eau de parfum, bringing additional depth and character to its namesake Californian desert. A picture of contrasts and soulful beauty, the scent opens with enveloping, musky ambrette and fresh Jamaican nesberry before melting into an intricately balanced heart. Powdery violet emphasises the dry, woody character of sandalwood before giving way to unexpected floral notes of magnolia. At the base, creamy chantilly musk meets amber for a crisp finish. The fragrance is housed in the brand’s signature flacon with an exclusive textural cap, inspired by traditional woodwork.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO La Sélection Nomade Discovery Set
listings.description: Dip your toes into the world of BYREDO with La Sélection Nomade Discovery Set: a three-piece edit (3 x 12ml) of industry-acclaimed fragrances that bottle complex memories and emotions in truly unique ways. Housed in the brand's instantly recognisable (and incredibly lust-have) chic and simple – yet quintessentially luxe – monochrome design, this presentation box puts three of the brand's highly coveted scents in the spotlight. A celebration of African culture, art, music and dance, the iconic Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum drenches you in rich history, euphoria, nostalgic longing and a touch of mystical allure via notes of earthy bucchu, zesty bergamot and a heady base of black amber. Created as an ode to Romani culture, the Gypsy Water Eau De Parfum's spellbinding blend of woody pine needle and sandalwood alongside intense amber and refreshing citrus (think: lemon and bergamot) evokes the fever and spirit of nights spent in the forest. With notes of pink pepper, white rose and aldehyde settling into a heart of neroli and base of musk and sandalwood, the Blanche Eau De Parfum is a fragrance almost transparent in nature, capturing a sense of innocence and classic beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Promise Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The beating heart of Promise Eau de Parfum is the marriage between two precious varieties of rose: rose essence from Bulgaria and rose absolute from Turkey. Fracdacric Malle celebrates this principle with a promise of his own, whose beating heart is made of two precious varieties of rose: rose essence from Bulgaria and rose absolute from Turkey. Lifted by apple, pink pepper, clove and bound to a sensuous base of patchouli, cypriol and labdanum; Promise Eau de Parfum is the embodiment of an unbreakable and invisible vow. Pledge your allegiance by picking from two sizes; 50ml (going steady) and 100ml (full-on commitment).

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Promise Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The beating heart of Promise Eau de Parfum is the marriage between two precious varieties of rose: rose essence from Bulgaria and rose absolute from Turkey.
