Pledge your allegiance by picking from two sizes; 50ml (going steady) and 100ml (full-on commitment).

listings.rawTitle: Liis Bo Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Coastal ease in scent form, Liis' Bo Eau de Parfum (50ml) exudes a sense of modern bohemia, underpinned by a woody heart. This richly layered fragrance starts with smoky guaiac wood and warm cedar at the base for an alluring starting entry point into the artist's mind. It's laced with mildly spiced redwood pine and balsamic frankincense at the heart, lending a sense of untethered authenticity and freedom. For a hit of spice and nonchalance, peppery elemi mingles tobacco leaf at the top, rounding off this nuanced scent with incense notes.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A complex aroma that captures the raw spirit of the wilderness, BYREDO's Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum plays with chords of musky ambrette, powdery violet, crisp amber and cedarwood, cultivating a woody and enticing composition. Housed in the brand's instantly recognisable (and incredibly lust-have) chic and simple – yet quintessentially luxe – monochrome bottles, BYREDO's Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum has quickly become a firm favourite in any respectable fragrance-phile's collection and regular guest on their Instagram grid too. An ode to the rare ghost flower that blooms in the xeric wilderness of the Mojave Desert, this aroma possesses a soulful, woody composition with graceful top notes of musky ambrette and fresh Jamaican nesberry; a heart note of powdery violet that unfurls to reveal sandalwood before warm chantilly musk rounds out a base of amber and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A complex aroma that captures the raw spirit of the wilderness, BYREDO's Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum plays with chords of musky ambrette, powdery violet, crisp amber and cedarwood, cultivating a woody and enticing composition. Housed in the brand's instantly recognisable (and incredibly lust-have) chic and simple – yet quintessentially luxe – monochrome bottles, BYREDO's Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum has quickly become a firm favourite in any respectable fragrance-phile's collection and regular guest on their Instagram grid too. An ode to the rare ghost flower that blooms in the xeric wilderness of the Mojave Desert, this aroma possesses a soulful, woody composition with graceful top notes of musky ambrette and fresh Jamaican nesberry; a heart note of powdery violet that unfurls to reveal sandalwood before warm chantilly musk rounds out a base of amber and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels' Share Paradis Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An ode to expertly made spirits and their artisanal nature, Angels Share Paradis (50ml) is a concentrated extrait de parfum belonging to Kilian's 'The Liquors' collection. Capturing the distinguished aroma of oak-matured liqueurs, this rich, savoury cologne grants a mesmeric scent trail. A medley of raspberry and cognac entices the senses to open, distilled in rose oil orpur for a luxuriously refined allure. As this heady redolence settles, notes of roasted praline and tonka bean absolut leave a smoky, caramel-like undertone that settles onto the skin with lingering warmth.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Boasting a blend of musky, enticing accords, the Habit Rouge Le Parfum (100ml) from Guerlain is a seductive scent that will have heads turning... A reinterpretation of Habit Rouge's iconic amber fragrance, this intense aroma opens with revitalising accords of bergamot and lime, only to then blend into rich tonalites of nutmeg and rum accord. Set alongside patchouli, it then lands on a bed of vanilla absolute and warm styrax to give the scent its unparalleled depth and musk. Presented in a decadent bottle, this luxury perfume is stamped with a darker red label to reflect the intensity of the bewitching fragrance...

listings.rawTitle: Liis in This World Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Exuding a sense of wonder and curiosity, Liis' In this World Eau de Parfum (50ml) pays tribute to the beauty of planet earth. This inspirational fragrance starts with a subtly spiced base made up of tonka wood and earthy sage, much like a foray into a forest. It mellows into a fruity, floral, sticky heart of fig, violet and lavender. At the top, crisp and invigorating blood orange and clarifying eucalyptus round this scent off on a mood-boosting, marvel-laden tone. Spritz it on to transport yourself into the midst of nature.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & DURGA Grapefruit Generation Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing D.S. & DURGA's Grapefruit Generation: a citrusy perfume for layering or wearing solo that unfurls from a quixotic freshness into notes of flowers in bloom, crisp leave and heady musks. Evolving from their Brooklyn roots (it all started in D.S.’s Bushwick apartment…), today D.S. & Durga’s luxury line is lauded by taste makers — or should we say, scent makers — and fragrance-ophiles around the world. Bottling a universe within each perfume and candle, each scent has a story, and the brand's Grapefruit Generation perfume is a love letter to the sixties. With top, opening notes of pomelo skin, elm leaf and silver that lead to a heart of tuberose and hawthorn flower before finishing with notes of grapefruit and animalic musk that linger on skin long after it's spritzed, this scent will garner a host of compliments and enquiries as to ""what perfume are you wearing?""…

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Book Expressive 100ml
listings.description: Open up your inner world (read: personal space) to an air of crisp, nature-inspired notes thanks to Commodity's Book Expressive Eau de Parfum (100ml). Perfect for those who want to savour their scent and hold it close like a page-turning novel, this warming fragrance blends accents of bergamot and eucalyptus to add a fresh, herby feel. Subtle but hard-to-miss traces of amber, vetiver, cedarwood, sandalwood and amyris anchor this perfume with the right amount of depth: one that is airy, optimistic yet still captivating.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Book+ Bold 100ml
listings.description: Open up your inner world (read: personal space) to an air of crisp, nature-inspired notes thanks to Commodity's Book+ Bold Eau de Parfum (100ml). Perfect for those who have a thing for the dramatics, this deepening fragrance blends top accents of violet inspired by fresh fields wrapped in morning dew, sparkling bergamot and eucalyptus for a herby aura. Made to turn heads and spur up compliments from passersby, this perfume mixes hard-to-miss traces of vetiver, cedarwood, velvet musk and sandalwood together for a captivating finale.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Paper+ Bold 100ml
listings.description: Take your senses on a poetic journey with Commodity's Paper+ Bold (100ml). Woody, leathery, powdery... this fragrance created by master perfumer Donna Ramanauskas enhances the original Paper formula, inspired by the beauty of letter writing, yet adds a higher concentration of iso e super for a barely-there yet skin-close feel. Creamy sandalwood adds warmth, before a veil of cashmere musk and sweet, spiced vanilla cast a cosy, inviting base. To finish, rich vetiver brings depth, resulting in an earthy fragrance that lingers on the skin and evolves into something deeper over time.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Cash Flower Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Looking to expand your fragrance wardrobe? Fugazzi's Cash Flower (100ml) will send senses swimming with notes of alluring rose, soft cashmere and warming amber. Created using petals from roses that have been harvested in the early morning when their scent is most potent (and before the sun and heat worsen the scents quality), this eau de parfum is a floral delight. After opening with notes of sweet roses, this fragrance boasts undertones of cashmere that adds a velvety softness. Then, notes of vibrant pepper and warm amber pack a punch to make it stand out. To finish? The mystery of musk and sandalwood will leave you wanting more. So, get ready to spritz to your hearts content.

listings.rawTitle: CRA-YON Passport Amour Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Housed in minimal, fuss-free packaging is a range of chic, scandi-inspired scents, courtesy of CRA-YON. With each genderless fragrance packed with only the most luxe ingredients, its time to welcome in the new age of perfume… But which scent is right for you? Choose from: ‘Sand Service’, a crisp, green and woody fragrance with notes of violet, papyrus and leather; ‘Vanilla CEO’, a vanilla-driven aroma with an unexpected citrus and amber zing; ‘Art Life’, a uniquely comforting but experimental blend of mandarin, neroli and soft woods; ‘Passport Amour’, a sensual cocktail of rose, oud, amber notes to help transport you to a world of beauty; ‘Continental’, a woody scent featuring notes from all over the world, including Brazilian orange, French cypress and Indian mint; and ‘Amie Amie’, a fresh, mood lifting fragrance that unites soft citrusy notes and even a hint of chocolate.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Eau de Campagne 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the art of French living, this nonchalant unisex fragrance — now available in 50ml and 100ml — harnesses the elegance of nature to inspire a feeling of well-being and calm. Consider it your new everyday luxury. Rich in scents of basil, wild herbs and lemon, SISLEY-PARIS’ Eau de Campagne creates the perfect harmony of citrus and grassy notes with a classic chypre base. At the heart, you’ll find the unique scent of green tomato leaves blended with jasmine, plum, lily of the valley, and geranium to deliver a beautifully fresh and floral accord. Underneath: oakmoss, musk, patchouli and vetiver round it off for a lightly woody and earthy finish. We think it’s a dreamy choice for daytime rendezvous , from alfresco parties to coffee dates.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Cédre Gingembre Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Awaken your senses with the L'OCCITANE Cédre Gingembre (Formerly Cap Cedrat) Eau de Toilette (50ml), a dynamic fragrance blending crisp, zesty notes with a woody, spicy heart. Fresh yet sophisticated, this signature scent features an invigorating fusion of ginger and cedar to create bold energy that lingers throughout the day. Modern and airy, this fragrance opens with notes of mint and pink pepper, which then deepen into a base of cedarwood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin en Mediterranee Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Wear the beauty of the outdoors on your skin with Hermès Un Jardin en Méditerranée Eau de Toilette (100ml), a whimsical, fresh-aired fragrance designed to teleport you to the private gardens of Tunisia. Satisfyingly sweet notes of fig tree mingle in harmony with green lentisk and delicate oleander, while citrus accents of lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange excite senses. Thought it couldn't get any better? Base notes of cypress, red cedar, juniper, pistachio and musk keep this efferve scent must-have anchored in mystery. Like a postcard you can wear, this olfactory favourite indulges one's desire for escapism to picturesque horizons.

listings.rawTitle: Liis Studied Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Liis' Studied Eau de Parfum (50ml) is the olfactory equivalent to reading, reflecting and reaching epiphanies. Opening the door to a room of one's own, this special scent is inspired by Virgina Woolf's famous novel. It casts the sense of a personal space with its unique blend of crisp, vivid, illuminating pear and warming, musky ambrette. Carrot and orris meld into the mix to add a touch of sweet earthiness, before mingling with the enveloping softness of cashmere, for a sense of pensiveness and intimacy. It's the ideal scent for when you want to feel refreshed in mind and perspective.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO La Sélection Florale Discovery Set
listings.description: Dip your toes into the world of BYREDO with La Sélection Florale Discovery Set: a three-piece edit (3 x 12ml) of industry-acclaimed fragrances that bottle complex memories and emotions in truly unique ways. Housed in the brand's instantly recognisable (and incredibly lust-have) chic and simple – yet quintessentially luxe – monochrome design, this presentation box puts three of the brand's highly coveted scents in the spotlight. With notes of pink pepper, white rose and aldehyde settling into a heart of neroli and base of musk and sandalwood, the Blanche Eau De Parfum is a fragrance almost transparent in nature, capturing a sense of innocence and classic beauty. A gentle tribute to selflessness and compassion, the subtly sweet Rose of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum celebrates the nickname given to nurses by soldiers during World War One. Having saved thousands of lives, this olfactory reminder serves as a heartfelt thank you. The embodiment of spring, La Tulipe Eau De Parfum celebrates the return to colour and sun that follows the depths of winter via top notes of cyclamen, freesia and rhubarb. These welcoming florals dance delicately over a heart of tulip before sinking beautifully into a warming base of blonde woods and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Fragrances Goudh
listings.description: For those wanting a fragrance that theyll never tire of, Goudh marries rich ingredients like oudh with sharp, sweet notes of mandarin and grapefruit resulting in a scent thats powerful, mysterious and multifaceted. Unashamedly luxurious, self-indulgent and enchanting, Goudh offers an almost otherworldly charm. It boasts opulently exotic top notes of muguet, grapefruit, mandarin and sambac jasmin, while its heart beats with ambergris, musk, leather, Indonesian patchouli, blackcurrent and Bulgarian rose. For the base, expect deep, velvety notes of oudh, vetivert java, Indian sandalwood and benzoin a startling (and rather pleasing!) contrast to the concoction's sweet, zesty notes. Prepped and ready to shower you with fragrance whenever the mood hits, Goudh is also available in an affectionately-named 'sleepover' size, which is perfect for stashing into overflowing overnight bags.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Parfum 1 Extrait de Parfum
listings.description: For those wanting a fragrance that theyll never tire of, Parfum 1 foregoes all traditional expectations in favour of a powerful, mysterious aroma. Made from ingredients that have spanned the mountainous plains of North East India and the sun of Mediterranean Spain, this parfum is a nod to freedom to boundlessness across time and space. Otherworldly and charmingly fresh, it boasts fruity top notes of citrus and blackcurrant with spearmint and mandarin, while its heart beats with davana herbs, frankincense, orange blossom and pink peppers. For the base, expect woody notes of patchouli, musk, sandalwood and cedarwood a startling (and rather pleasing!) contrast to the concoction's sweet, zesty notes. Prepped and ready to shower you with fragrance whenever the mood hits, Parfum 1 is also available in an affectionately-named 'sleepover' size, which is perfect for stashing into overflowing overnight bags.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Isa - 50ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. The Isa scent is a seductive choice that blends fresh jasmine with tantalising spices for an olfactory journey through light and dark. L’Eau Rêvée d’Isa plays with lightness and depth to create a surprising and ambivalent scent that seduces the senses. It opens with top notes of bergamot, black pepper and pink berries before revealing a crisp heart of jasmine, rose and green tea. Musky and woody base notes round out the essence of this modern fragrance. Think: masculine and feminine, subtle and intense, delicate and rich. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Velvet Expressive 100ml
listings.description: A unique signature scent, Commodity's Velvet Expressive (100ml) reveals an unexpectedly delicate yet smoky silage on the skin. Perfect for those who want more out of their fragrance wardrobe, this warm rendition blends subtle accents of coconut water with roasted almonds. Then, as the minutes pass and the scent come to life, you'll begin to notice delicate rose petals striking the just-right balance between soft and inviting. Finally, at the base you are met with creamy, woody accords of smoky musk, amber and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Vanilla Musk Duo 2 x 5ml
listings.description: This KAYALI duo features two captivating fragrances: Vanilla 28 and Freedom Musk Santal 34, each housed in sleek travel-sized bottles. Vanilla 28 is a rich, velvety scent blending warm vanilla, brown sugar and tonka bean, creating an inviting, sweet aroma that enhances your natural glow. Freedom Musk Santal 34 offers a subtly spiced, woody warmth with notes of pink pepper, freesia, lily petals, orange blossom and candied amber, finished with a sensuous musk santal base. Whether layered or worn separately, these scents deliver a memorable, enchanting olfactory experience that turns heads and leaves a lasting impression. Contents: Vanilla 28 (5ml) Freedom Musk Santal 34 (5ml)

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Livin'A Vida Cheirosa Set (Worth £55.00)
listings.description: Inspired by the sunshine-soaked shores of Rio, Sol de Janeiro’s Livin'A Vida Cheirosa Set features five bestselling scents in travel-friendly sizes. Dip into familiar fruity blends, opt for gourmand vanilla classics or try something new with this colourful collection. From the pistachio-vanilla signature of Cheirosa 62 to the rich, sugared violet and sandalwood depth of 59, no two days need to smell the same… Contents: Cheirosa 62 (30ml) Cheirosa 91 (30ml) Cheirosa 59 (30ml) Cheirosa 68 (30ml) Cheirosa 48 (30ml)

listings.rawTitle: OUAI Instant Ouai-Cation Kit 100ml
listings.description: Escape to your favourite destinations anytime with the OUAI Instant Ouai-Cation Kit, your portable passport to a world of effortless elegance. This luxe set features four iconic fragrance mists inspired by sun-soaked getaways: Santorini, Ibiza, St. Barts and Melrose Place, each designed to evoke a different mood of wanderlust. Spritz any time you need a mood lift, a moment of calm or an instant boost of confidence. Whether channelling the relaxed glamour of the Mediterranean or the vibrant energy of the islands, these scents transform your routine into a luxurious escape. Compact and chic, this set is perfect for travel, gifting, or simply elevating your everyday vibe. Contents: Santorini Fragrance Mist (25ml) Ibiza Fragrance Mist (25ml) St. Barts Fragrance Mist (25ml) Melrose Place Fragrance Mist (25ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Sweet Obsessions Set (Worth £112.00)
listings.description: Experience KAYALI's elevated take on gourmand with the Sweet Obsessions Set. Featuring a fragrance for every craving, this four-piece selection stars Vanilla 28, the brand's intimate, almost edible creamy vanilla and brown sugar scent. Bottling a lighter, more playful twist on 28, Vanilla Candy satisfies your sweet tooth with notes of candied pear, bubble gum and a drizzle of white caramel that lingers with a syrupy softness. Topped with sugar spun Yum Boujee Marshmallow or swirled with a spritz of juicy peach and rose Fleur Majesty, layer without limits to find your bespoke signature scent. Contents: Vanilla | 28 (10ml) Vanilla Candy (10ml) Yum Boujee Marshmallow (10ml) Fleur Majesty (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Discovery Layering Set (8x1.5ml)
listings.description: KAYALI's Discovery Layering Set (8x1.5) bottles up eight of the brand's most-loved scents in perfectly portable form, each ready to mist, mix or mood-match. Glide through syrupy clouds of Vanilla Candy, fall headfirst into Yum Pistachio Gelato's patisserie haze, or dip into Vanilla 28's rich creaminess. From Eden Juicy Apple's sparkling spritz to Fleur Majesty's bouquet of floral hues, each scent has its own sensorial story. Layer them to shape something uniquely yours or wear solo for an instant olfactive refresh. One spritz and you're in the mood, whether that's sugar-dusted, fresh and fruity or subtly floral. Contents: Vanilla | 28 (1.5ml) Yum Pistachio Gelato (1.5ml) Eden Juicy Apple (1.5ml) Eden Sparkling Lychee (1.5ml) Vanilla Candy (1.5ml) Yum Boujee Marshmallow (1.5ml) Fleur Majesty (1.5ml) Utopia Vanilla Coco (1.5ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Fleur Majesty Duo - Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 50ml + 10ml
listings.description: One for the dressing table, one for on-the-go journeys, KAYALI's Fleur Majesty Duo features a full and mini sized bottle of the iconic sweet-scented perfume. Warm, floral and fresh, this mesmeric fragrance blends juicy pear, peach, peony and violet woods, all weaved around a regal rose accord. Refined and romantic, playful yet powerful, spray this eau de parfum alone or layer with the brand's signature scents for a unique sillage. Contents: Fleur Majesty Rose Royale Eau de Parfum (50ml) Fleur Majesty Rose Royale Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Marshmallow Candy Mini Duo 2 x 5ml
listings.description: The Marshmallow Candy Mini Duo featuring Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 and Boujee Marshmallow 81 offers a delectable scent experience inspired by sweet treats and indulgent desserts. Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 is a playful, gourmand fragrance bursting with glazed candied pear, marshmallow, bubble gum and jellybeans, layered over a heart of vanilla cream and white caramel, with warm woody undertones of tonka bean, rock sugar and patchouli. The Boujee Marshmallow 81 is a sumptuous, dessert-like scent blending fluffy pink marshmallow, strawberry, coconut and whipped vanilla, accented by bright notes of pink lady apple, lemon and nectarine blossom, leaving a lingering, irresistible sweetness. Together, these fragrances evoke a sense of indulgence, fun and luxurious sweetness, perfect for those who love to make a delicious statement. Contents: Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum (5ml) Yum Boujee Marshmallow | 81 (5ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Eden Obsessions Eau de Parfum Miniature Set
listings.description: Discover the playful allure of KAYALI’s Eden Obsession Miniature Set, a limited-edition collection that’s perfect for gifting or collecting. This set features four addictive, layerable fruity floral fragrances: Eden Juicy Apple, Eden Plush Pear, Eden Sweet Peach and Eden Sparkling Lychee, each in a mini. Bursting with juicy fruits, flirty florals and irresistible sweetness, these scents offer a different expression of Eden’s joyful spirit, whether vibrant, plush, radiant or playful. Wear them alone or mix and match to craft your signature mood. Encased in vibrant lacquered bottles inspired by Middle Eastern design, these fragrances are a celebration of happiness, confidence and effortless style. Contents: Eden Juicy Apple | 01 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Eden Plush Pear | 23 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Eden Sweet Peach | 35 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Eden Sparkling Lychee | 39 Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Love, Don’t be Shy Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Like the exhilarating innocence of your first love, Kilian’s Love, Dont Be Shy Eau de Parfum (30ml) encapsulates those first nervous giggles, that initial tentative kiss, and that tingling anticipation for the future, in one bottle. Exhilarating and unforgettable, this seductive scent begins with the blend of tender orange blossom absolute, juicy honeysuckle and plush rose. Just as two people can perfectly complement and complete each other, the formula is effortlessly and divinely finished with sweet marshmallow sugar accord, warm amber and sharp neroli. The result? A gentle, sensual, addictive fragrance that lasts, without being too overpowering.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Capri In A Bottle Lemon Sugar 14 Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Whisk your senses away to a summer spent on an Italian island with KAYALI's Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar 14 Eau de Parfum (10ml). When you first spritz this fragrance, you'll be met with notes of bright lemon and sugar. It then blooms into a heart of spicy, powder and floral freesia twisted with tart and fruity raspberry. As for the base? It lies on a bed of creamy, comforting vanilla and musk. Simply pop this portable, on-the-go perfume in your bag and you'll be able to transport yourself to sun-drenched shorelines when you wish.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Joining KAYALI's ranks of delicious-smelling scents is the KAYALI Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 Eau de Parfum (100ml), AKA a sweet lover's dream. Bursting with mouthwatering accords, this fragrance opens with notes of gourmand hazelnut and pistachio, blended with sweet rum for a tantalising first impression. In the heart, it blooms into white peony, jasmine and white peach to offer a delicate fruity floral that balances the sweetness. To finish? Enjoy a delicious base of whipped cream, fluffy marshmallow, creamy sandalwood and tonka for a delectable treat. Fully expect to have friends and family asking how you smell *so* good!

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Alto Astral 50ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent collection with the Byredo Alto Astral Eau de Parfum (50ml), a sense-awakening fragrance that captures the essence of optimism and warmth. The fragrance opens with sparkling top notes of bergamot and bitter orange, delivering a fresh and vibrant introduction. At its heart, delicate jasmine petals and soft rose bring a floral elegance, while creamy sandalwood and musk provide a smooth, woody base. Inspired by the Brazilian Portuguese expression for positive mindset, this perfume is sure to uplift anyone lucky enough to be within its aura.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus for Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Start your day with a spritz of The House of Creed's vibrant Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum. Opening with thrilling top notes of crisp green apple, fragrant pink pepper and zesty bergamot, this scent sational blend then blossoms into a floral heart with the infusion of sweet rose, powdery lilac and tangy ylang-ylang. This lively and sensual perfume then dries down to a base of cedarwood, patchouli, musk and ambroxan which balances its citrus and fruity charm. We can't wait for you to experience this sparkling creation.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus for Her Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Start your day with a spritz of The House of Creed's vibrant Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum. Opening with thrilling top notes of crisp green apple, fragrant pink pepper and zesty bergamot, this scent sational blend then blossoms into a floral heart with the infusion of sweet rose, powdery lilac and tangy ylang-ylang. This lively and sensual perfume then dries down to a base of cedarwood, patchouli, musk and ambroxan which balances its citrus and fruity charm. We can't wait for you to experience this sparkling creation.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Santal 34 EDP 100ml
listings.description: KAYALI's Freedom Musk Santal 34 Eau de Parfum (100ml) enhances the sweet, simplistic warmth of the skin's scent. Housed in a glossy nude bottle from top to bottom, this subtly spiced blend unites pink pepper, freesia and velvety lily petals to open. Orange blossom and candied amber lend luminous depth, while a rich base of musk santal lingers with a sensuous, animalic edge, wrapping the skin in refined, woody warmth to close.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 02 Travel Size Refill
listings.description: This beguiling concoction is based around the single synthetic note of Ambroxan, an aroma-molecule that harnesses all the sweet, earthy, musky characteristics of natural ambergris, a commonly-used ingredient in perfumery. Like its cousin Molecule 01, 02 waxes and wanes throughout the day, fading, only to resurface just when you've almost forgotten you're wearing it. As with everything else Geza Schoen does – nothing is overdone or “gimmicky”. If you’re after a signature scent, this unisex mystifying and electrifying number ticks every box, melding with your natural pheromones for a truly unique olfactory outing.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Milk Orchid - Expressive 10ml
listings.description: Elevate your fragrance ritual with the Commodity Milk Orchid - Expressive (10ml), a luminous, airy scent that captures the essence of modern nostalgia. This is an exquisite floral gourmand that melds shimmering fig milk, vanilla orchid and magnolia with warm cotton, coconut cream and macadamia milk. The scent evolves beautifully over time, revealing a layered complexity, from tart and creamy fig milk and coconut initially, to lush floral notes of vanilla orchid and magnolia, culminating in a warm, comforting base of macadamia milk and sandalwood. Perfect for those who want a fragrance that’s both luminous and multidimensional, it leaves a captivating, memorable impression.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Utopia Vanilla Coco 21 Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by Mona Kattan's travels to the Seychelles, the Utopia Vanilla Coco 21 (50ml) evokes scents of paradise with no flight necessary. Indulge your senses with top notes of warm honeysuckle, zesty Italian lemon and coconut, alongside middle notes of jasmine, tuberose and gardenia. Perfectly balanced by sandalwood, musk and earthy patchouli, and housed in an iridescent bottle with brushed gold, this fragrance will sit perfectly on your pulse points and on your dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: OUAI Fragrance Mist Melrose Place 97ml
listings.description: The OUAI Melrose Place Fragrance Mist (97ml) lets you wrap yourself in one of the brand's most iconic scents from head to toe. Inspired by the sun-drenched streets of Los Angeles, this beautifully chic fragrance is a love letter to the city of stars. A fresh, velvety bouquet of rose, jasmine, freesia and peony come together with lychee and white musk in a light, long-lasting formula that can be spritzed all over your hair and body. It's the perfect way to refresh your scent throughout the day, leaving a subtle, impossibly chic trail of fragrance wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Eden Juicy Apple 01 Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Like freshly squeezed juice but for the senses, KAYALI's refreshing Eden Juice Apple 01 (50ml) is a vibrant scent that cloaks skin in a bouquet of fruits and florals. One of your five-a-day, this fruity fusion takes you on an olfactive journey, opening with top notes of juicy red apples, sparkling pink grapefruit and lychee. It then follows through into accords of raspberry blossom, tart blackcurrant and intoxicating jasmine, only to wrap you in a blanket of creamy vanilla flower, sultry amber and sensual musk. Utterly irresistible, this refreshing fragrance brings joy from the very first spritz...

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 48 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Experience the bright notes of Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa '48 Perfume Mist (90ml), a scent inspired by bikini season in Brazil. With every spritz of this immersive fragrance, you'll journey through juicy notes of guava nectar and coconut water. What's more, a tropical surge of sunlit orchid, lemon twist and wild orris will teleport you straight to the beaches. And that's all before you're encapsulated by the sweet aromatics of pink musk and vanilla cloud. What are you waiting for? Start spritzing!

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Eden Sparkling Lychee Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Like a freshly squeezed juice, KAYALI's refreshing Eden Sparkling Lychee Eau de Parfum is a radiant and delicious scent. Dressing your pulse points (and mane) in a bouquet of bright accords, this fragrance opens with mouth-watering notes of juicy blackcurrant, sparkling lychee and red apple. It then blooms into a bouquet of soft rose damascena, spicy jasmine sambac and sweetened with candied violets (so dreamy!). As for the base? It features an alluring blend of sugared amber, creamy cedarwood, musk and sensual vanilla. So be prepared to be tempted to add it to your scent wardrobe, this is 'Eden' after all...

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & DURGA I Don't Know What Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Designed to add that je ne sais quoi to your signature scent, D.S. & Durga's I Don’t Know What is a fragrance enhancer that allows you to become your own perfumer. With simple monochrome bottles that let the scents do the talking, D.S. & Durga’s gender-neutral perfumes make a fine addition to any vanity. Carefully crafted from vegan ingredients that are cherry-picked for aromatic payoff and quality, each scent is shaped in New York City but their stories span the world over. Like a building with only a structure — the interior is for you to fill as you please — the modern aroma can be worn alone or layered over perfumes and oils to enhance their notes. Made with a fresh bergamot accord, an amber-like vetiver acetate and firsantol (a lingering sandalwood), this innovative spritz highlights other scents rather than masking them.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Love Frequency Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Radiate romance with Charlotte Tilbury's Collection of Emotions Love Frequency Eau de Parfum (50ml). Opening with sweet and spicy pink pepper, this fragrance bursts into a floral explosion of sultry saffron, alluring rose extract and deep rose essential. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of warm cashmere wood, alluring amber and intoxicating patchouli. You'll want to embrace this fragrance, while its intense scent trail will no doubt leave people wondering what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Fleur Majesty Rose Royale | 31 Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Roll out the red carpet, KAYALI's Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31 Eau de Parfum (100ml) has arrived. Crowned the 'Queen of Flowers' the heady and sweet scent of the humble rose is the hero of this fragrance, intertwined with citrusy splashes of sparking mandarin and sweet, juicy peach. For a flicker of majesty, it blooms into a bouquet of earthy violet wood, champagne-like magnolia and white peony, conjuring a sensual, yet powerful fragrance all captured in a suitably romantic, diamond-shaped bottle. In the court of fragrance, KAYALI holds the throne.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Limonada Gelada Mist 90ml LE
listings.description: Cool and uplift with the Sol de Janeiro Limonada Gelada Mist (90ml), a refreshing body and hair fragrance inspired by sun-soaked Brazilian escapes. Bursting with bright citrus notes and a crisp, invigorating twist, this lightweight mist delivers an instant refresh while delicately scenting the skin. Expect a vibrant, zesty finish that leaves you feeling energised, radiant and ready for summer.

listings.rawTitle: WHO IS ELIJAH The Discovery Set 12
listings.description: Discover your new olfactory journey with WHO IS ELIJAH's The Discovery Set 12, a curated collection of mini fragrances designed to explore every mood and personality. Each 2ml bottle offers a glimpse into a different story, from bold and daring to soft and mysterious. Perfect for those who love to switch up their scent game, this set invites you to find your signature or simply enjoy trying something new. Whether you're feeling adventurous with Cherry Fiesta, mysterious with Desert Nights or confident with Electric Soul, this collection has a fragrance for every moment. Which scent will become your new favourite? Contents: Chemical Addiction Eau de Parfum (2ml) Cherry Fiesta Eau de Parfum (2ml) Desert Nights Eau de Parfum (2ml) Electric Soul Eau de Parfum (2ml) Haze Eau de Parfum (2ml) His|Her Eau de Parfum (2ml) Morning After Eau de Parfum (2ml) Muse Eau de Parfum (2ml) Ocean Eyes Eau de Parfum (2ml) Rebel Rose Eau de Parfum (2ml) Wall Street Eau de Parfum (2ml) Nomad Eau de Parfum (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Miniature Fragrance Discovery Collection
listings.description: Embark on an array of adventures with Jo Loves' A Miniature Fragrance Discovery Collection. Housing seven of the brand's bestselling perfumes, this set spans across a variety of fragrance families that suit every taste (and mood). In the fruity realm, there's a sweet and sharp mango scent, alongside a citrus-fuelled grapefruit one. If you're into more floral accords, then this collection includes a white rose aroma. Plus, for the scent extraordinaries, there's a rich and sensual amber perfume and a bitterly herbaceous orange one. Be prepared to fall head over heels for your next favourite or, better yet, love them all. Contents: Pomelo (2ml) Jo By Jo Loves (2ml) Mango Thai Lime (2ml) Cobalt Patchouli & Cedarwoods (2ml) White Rose & Lemon Leaves (2ml) Amber Lime & Bergamot (2ml) Green Orange & Coriander (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Jelly Perfume Balm 4g
listings.description: Meet Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa 68 Jelly Perfume Balm (4g) a concentrated, alcohol-free solid fragrance is your personal fragrance sidekick; compact, easy to apply and endlessly fresh. This translucent balm glides smoothly onto skin, melting into a vibrant blend of pink dragonfruit, Brazilian jasmine, and ocean air. Perfect for discreet touch-ups on the go, it offers up to 10 hours of a fruity, floral scent, no spills, no fuss. Stack it with other scents or carry it solo for a truly personal, long-lasting fragrance moment. Whether at the desk or on a night out, this pocket-sized balm keeps you scent alive, wherever life takes you, just simply glide it on.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 200ml
listings.description: The Escentric Molecules O1 (200ml) adapts to your skin, putting Iso E Super at its centre. This synthetic molecule lingers close, weaving a woody, magnetic aura that shifts with every movement to create a scent that's uniquely yours. Lime peel and pink pepper open with a hint of hedione and orris, creating a fresh lift that melts into balsamic warmth and soft musks. Clean and minimalist, the scent lingers lightly on the skin, letting individuality lead.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Scent Space Expressive Discovery Kit
listings.description: Find your new signature scent with Commodity's Expressive Discovery Kit. This bestselling kit includes the brand's Expressive Scent Space collection, so you can find your favourite fragrance in their most balanced projection. Perfect for those who want to make a statement without taking over, enjoy fruity renditions in Juice, musky accords in Milk, woody trances in Gold and so much more. Which will be your go-to? Contents: Book- Expressive (2ml) Gold- Expressive (2ml) Juice- Expressive (2ml) Moss- Expressive (2ml) Paper- Expressive (2ml) Milk- Expressive (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 8.5ml Discovery Set
listings.description: Get more from your favourite notes with the Escentric Molecules Molecule Discovery Set (8.5ml x 5), which is designed for perfume lovers who are still exploring their favourite notes. Crafted with minimalists in mind, each vial celebrates the singular scents that make up our fragrance wardrobes. From ambery accords to velvety blends, these molecular-level perfumes add a level of dimension to your aura that will make heads turn for the right reasons. Contents: Molecular 01 (8.5ml) Molecular 02 (8.5ml) Molecular 03 (8.5ml) Molecular 04 (8.5ml) Molecular 05 (8.5ml)

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Jelly Perfume Balm 4g
listings.description: Meet Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa 62 Jelly Perfume Balm (4g) a concentrated, alcohol-free solid fragrance is your personal fragrance sidekick; compact, easy to apply and irresistibly sunny. This translucent balm glides smoothly onto skin, melting into an intoxicating gourmand blend of pistachio, salted caramel and vanilla. Perfect for discreet touch-ups on the go, it offers up to 10 hours of luminous, delicious scent, no spills, no fuss. Stack it with other scents or carry it solo for a truly personal, long-lasting fragrance moment. Whether at the desk or on a night out, this pocket-sized balm keeps you scent alive, wherever life takes you, just simply glide it on.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier Des Fleurs Plage Du Figuier Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the sun-drenched elegance of the Mediterranean with Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Plage du Figuier Eau de Parfum (50ml) a luminous ode to coastal bliss. Inspired by the brand founder's love for Ramatuelle, perfumer Ane Ayo unveils a warm, fleshy fig accentuated by radiant orange blossom. Bright top notes of bergamot and eucalyptus evoke the invigorating sea breeze, while a heart of black fig and floral accords deepen the scent's pulpy richness. Base notes of cedarwood, fir balsam and ambrox add warmth and sensuality, evoking sun-warmed sand and coastal landscapes. Housed in a signature undulating glass bottle with a sand-coloured cap, it captures effortless Mediterranean elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier Des Fleurs Sous Les Pins Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the serene scent of the Mediterranean with the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Sous les Pins Eau de Parfum (150ml). Celebrating the quiet majesty of sun-warmed pine forests and resinous eucalyptus, this woody aromatic fragrance captures the essence of Porquerolles' lush landscapes. Crafted by perfumer Quentin Bisch, it offers a fresh, green escape that's both invigorating and subtly sophisticated. Top notes of pine needle absolute and bergamot evoke a crisp, breezy freshness, while heart notes of eucalyptus and cypress deepen the woody, aromatic trail. Warm base notes of ambrofix and benzoin add a touch of resinous depth. Encased in the brand's signature undulating glass bottle, this fragrance embodies effortless elegance and the quiet beauty of the Mediterranean horizon.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Gold Expressive 100ml
listings.description: Craving something *sweeter*? Meet Commodity's Gold Expressive Eau de Parfum (100ml), a delectable, ready-to-spritz treat designed to linger on the skin. Perfect for those who want more out of their fragrance wardrobe, this warming rendition blends gourmand notes of vanilla with juniper berries and creamy musk for an indulgent scent. Commanding, hard-to-miss traces of amber, sandalwood and benzoin begin to pull through after a few minutes, striking the just-right balance between soft and inviting.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Indigo Eau De Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl oz.
listings.description: Say hello to the Indigo Eau de Parfum (50ml) from NEST New York, a spiced scent bursting with notes of lemon, bergamot and wild figs.. Inspired by a trip the founder took to Europe in 1992, this sensorial aroma is reminiscent of a Moroccan tea she had during her time on Bond Street in London. Unashamedly luxurious, self-indulgent and enchanting, it boasts revitalising accords of Italina lemon and orange bergamot, which is then sliced with opulent notes of Moroccan tea, Kashmir wood, and wild figs from the south of France. Now, all that's left to do is to sit back and enjoy your new spicy, signature scent. Ah...pure bliss.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Cologne Intense Discovery Collection 5x1.5ml
listings.description: Dip into the world of Jo Malone London with the Cologne Intense Discovery Collection, featuring five of its highly acclaimed fragrances. Wrap yourself in Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense, a floral cologne with notes of scarlet poppy and creamy tonka bean. Up next, the Velvet Rose & Oud Cologne Intense is spicy and warm with hints of clove and Damask rose. The Oud & Bergamot Cologone Intense is a mysterious and charming scent with cedarwood and bergamot accords, while the Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense features fresh woody undertones. Finally the Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense transports the senses to lush, golden sands with nuances of lavender and tonka. Contents: Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense (1.5ml) Velvet Rose & Oud Cologne Intense (1.5ml) Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense (1.5ml) Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense (1.5ml) Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense (1.5ml)

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Collection of Emotions Love Frequency 100ml
listings.description: Radiate romance with Charlotte Tilbury's Collection of Emotions Love Frequency Eau de Parfum (100ml). Opening with sweet and spicy pink pepper, this fragrance bursts into a floral explosion of sultry saffron, alluring rose extract and deep rose essential. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of warm cashmere wood, alluring amber and intoxicating patchouli. You'll want to embrace this fragrance, while its intense scent trail will no doubt leave people wondering what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Debaser Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Channel the rebellious spirit of music with D.S. & Durga Debaser (100ml) a seductive, evocative fragrance inspired by summer heat, punk and raw emotion. Opening with fresh bergamot, green leaf and pear stem, it immediately sparks a sense of vibrancy. Heart notes of fig, coconut milk and iris add a lush, creamy depth, while blond woods, tonka bean, and moss create a warm, sexy base. Like a summer night filled with energy and passion, this fragrance is both bold and intoxicating. Perfect for those who want a scent that’s daring, nostalgic and irresistibly cool.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Collection of Emotions Magic Energy 100ml
listings.description: Enliven the senses with Charlotte Tilbury's Collection of Emotions Magic Energy Eau de Parfum (100ml). Opening with notes of earthy myrtle and citrusy bergamot, this scent cascades into accords of woody cypress, sweet jasmine and herbaceous seaweed absolute at the heart. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of cashmere wood, minty palo santo and sensual ambergris tones. You'll want to embrace this fragrance, while its intense scent trail will no doubt leave people wondering what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover the art of minimalism with Juliette Has a Gun’s Not a Perfume (50ml), a uniquely pure and subtle scent crafted from a single molecule, Cetalox. Designed for those who appreciate understated luxury, it blends seamlessly with your skin, creating a personalized, fleeting aura that evolves uniquely on each wearer. Ideal for layering or wearing solo, it’s perfect for fragrance-sensitive souls seeking a hypoallergenic yet captivating scent. The minimalist white bottle embodies purity, making it a chic addition to your collection. Embrace the beauty of simplicity and let this iconic fragrance subtly enhance your natural allure.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Drunk Lovers 15ml
listings.description: Characterised by a whirlwind of warmth and electric energy, let BORNTOSTANDOUT's Drunk Lovers Eau De Parfum (15ml) intoxicate the senses with its lust-fuelled fragrance. Rich and liquor-like, this scent swirls vibrant citrus fruits with heady spices, pulsing in an exciting infusion topped by animalic musk. Equal parts playful and seductive, think delicious nuances of grapefruit and bergamot, dancing amongst velvety brandy, cinnamon and sandalwood in an unexpected olfactive union. Expertly intertwined for long-lasting intensity, this perfume calls upon all thrill seekers to indulge in the heat of the moment.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance - Amber Lime & Bergamot 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by a sense of glamour and celebration, immerse the senses in the rich and velvety aroma of Amber Lime & Bergamot (50ml) from Jo Loves A Fragrance. Intertwining a fresh medley of bergamot and mandarin, this deliciously rich scent awakens the senses as it flows into heart notes of warm amber and cedarwood. Unique and unisex, it finishes with notes of suede and patchouli, making it an unforgettable fragrance that will not only take you from day to night, but will have everyone asking what you're wearing. Housed in a classic Jo Loves red bottle and gift box, it makes a perfect present for a loved one... or yourself, as we say this could be almost too good to gift.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: TOM FORD Black Orchid Body Spray (150ml) casts a floral-spice haze over the skin with every spritz. This chypre-inspired composition blends rich truffle and black orchid with warm patchouli and smooth vanilla. A 360° spray applicator makes it effortless to mist from any angle. Wear it alone for a softer take on the iconic aroma or layer over the eau de parfum for added depth.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Experience the bright notes of Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa '68 Perfume Mist (240ml), a scent inspired by the colourful energy of Brazil's Tropicália Movement. With every spritz of this immersive fragrance, you'll journey through sweet notes of lychee essence and pink dragonfruit. What's more, a sense-awakening surge of fresh ocean air, blooms of hibiscus and Brazilian jasmine will teleport you to the vibrant landscapes of South America. And that's all before you're encapsulated by the warm summer notes of sheer vanilla and a sun musk base. What are you waiting for? Start spritzing!

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Jasminum Sambac Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of a springtime sunrise, Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Jasminum Sambac Eau de Parfum (50ml) delivers a bouquet of rich florals. Notes of fresh jasmine petals are lifted by morning dew accord and green gardenia leaf notes. The heart blooms with jasminum sambac softened by hedione, while a subtle base of vetiver, ambrox and white musk adds a lingering warmth. Crafted for layering or solo wear, this floral Eau de Parfum leaves a soft, evocative trail.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Orchidée de Minuit Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: Enriched with sweet, honeyed florals, the Atelier des Fleurs Orchidée de Minuit Eau de Parfum (50ml) pays homage to night-blooming botanicals. Taking on a captivating shade of blue, this bottle is brimming with enigmatic flowers, amber accords and gourmand accents. Inspired by the orchid plant and its ability to unfold in the dark and exhale a sweet smell, this eau de parfum combines orchid, jasmine, rum and benzoin in a heady blend. Drying down on a creamy base of vanilla and musk, it warms into a sensual, elegant scent with wear, guaranteeing a long-lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: WHO IS ELIJAH Poetic Dance EDP 50ML
listings.description: Bottling the art of transformation, Poetic Dance from Who is Elijah (50ml) is an expressive, suitably mysterious scent holding untold stories, moods and moments all waiting to be written by you. Dreamy and evocative, this radiant composition moves with the delicacy of a butterfly's wing, opening with the honeyed softness of ripe fig, entwined in the earthy essence of bright bergamot. As the fragrance settles, its poeticism comes into sharp focus with the creamy warmth of tonka bean and powdery allure of heliotrope blooms.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Frangipani Flower Cologne 30ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Frangipani Flower Cologne (30ml) drifts in like warm air off a distant shoreline, where sunlit petals and soft citrus linger gently on skin. Opening with a bright twist of lemon, this solar floral melts into frangipani and ylang ylang for a creamy, sun-warmed softness that wears from day to evening. As it settles, smooth sandalwood adds depth, grounding the brightness with a soft, cocooning finish. Light yet noticeable, it sits close to the skin with a long-lasting olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian The Mini Fragrance Wardrobe For Her 8x2ml
listings.description: Say hello to Maison Francis Kurkdjian's The Mini Fragrance Wardrobe for Her, which features some of the maison's most celebrated scents. Included is the legendary Baccarat Rouge 540, a true icon, alongside the crisp, luminous Petit Matin, the romantic floral À La Rose and the warm, elegant Grand Soir. Also included are the fresh, luminous Apom and the unisex Gentle Fluidity Gold, each crafted with the brand's signature artistry. Designed for layering, travel or discovering your signature scent, these miniatures in sleek, portable bottles offer effortless versatility and high-end sophistication, making it an essential wardrobe for fragrance lovers seeking everyday luxury on the go. Contents: Aqua Media Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum (2ml) À La Rose Eau de Parfum (2ml) Petit Matin Eau de Parfum (2ml) Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum (2ml) Amyris Femme Eau de Parfum (2ml) Grand Soir Eau de Parfum (2ml) Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum (2ml) Apom Eau de Parfum (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Madagascar Vanilla Perfume Oil 30ml / 1 fl oz.
listings.description: Featuring one of the most expensive crops in the world, the gourmand Madagascar Vanilla Perfume Oil captures the magic behind the country’s rich and enchanted landscapes. Artfully blended with the brand’s signature baobab essence, the oil soaks into your skin, leaving behind a fresh long-lasting fragrance no one will be able to ignore. As the warm essence of the vanilla bean evokes the sweet sense of tranquillity, the coconut base hints to the tropical settings of the dreamlike destination. Now, all that’s left to do is to sit back and enjoy your calming new signature scent.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Clary Sage 100ml
listings.description: Fresh herbs meet velvety woods in the Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Clary Sage (100ml), a fresh, floral fragrance that feels relaxed, modern and subtly addictive. The warm, woody aura of Iso E Super contrasts with the freshness of Mediterranean clary sage (used in oil and absolute form) for a crisp, airy scent. Complemented by blooming floral nuances of elderflower and gentle musky facets, the easy-to-wear fragrance offers warmth and longevity.

listings.rawTitle: Liis Celestial Object 50ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent ritual with the Liis Celestial Object (50ml), a parfum inspired by the cosmos and our intrinsic connection to the universe. Named after an astronomical term, this fragrance captures the magic of being made of stars, blending celestial and earthly elements into a captivating olfactory experience. Notes of juicy quince and pink pepper introduce a bright, energetic opening, while incense, almond and rice paper evoke a sense of mystery and serenity. Warm labdanum and tonka bean deepen the aroma with a rich, comforting finish. Crafted with organic sugarcane alcohol, this is a luminous scent that invites you to feel grounded-yet-connected to the infinite universe, an ethereal signature for every moment.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Collection of Emotions More Sex 100ml
listings.description: Feel sensual with Charlotte Tilbury's Collection of Emotions More Sex Eau de Parfum (100ml). Opening with notes of spicy black pepper and herbaceous juniper berry oil, this alluring scent cascades into accords of warming ambroxan and rich leather tones at its heart. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of velvety musk, soft sandalwood and creamy caledonia. Taking you from day to dusk, this powerful perfume will no doubt leave people wondering what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angel's Share On The Rocks Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Cool, crisp, and unmistakably gourmand, Kilian Angel Share On The Rocks (100ml) reimagines the warmth of cognac with an icy twist. Inspired by Kilian Hennessy's ritual of serving his drink over ice, it opens with bright bergamot, grapefruit and aldehydes that give a sharp, sparkling lift. Beneath, smooth cognac essence, myrrh resin and tonka bean unfold into a soft, lingering warmth. Housed in a frosted tumbler-inspired bottle, the fragrance glides from cool to warm, like cognac poured over ice.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 87 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Bringing Brazilian vibes (without the air fare), Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa 67 Perfume Mist (240ml) encapsulates memories of beach parties, tan lines and ocean breezes with a single spritz. The epitome of summer nostalgia, this fragrance is centred around a heart of heady floral solar tuberose, ylang ylang and juicy mango. It opens with leite de coco (AKA sweet coconut) and hints of warm sand, which is then anchored by notes of creamy vanilla and sensual amber essence for a fragrance that lingers all day. In other words, this powerful mist really is like sunshine in a bottle, and who doesn't love that?

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 48 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Experience the bright notes of Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa '48 Perfume Mist (240ml), a scent inspired by bikini season in Brazil. With every spritz of this immersive fragrance, you'll journey through juicy notes of guava nectar and coconut water. What's more, a tropical surge of sunlit orchid, lemon twist and wild orris will teleport you straight to the beaches. And that's all before you're encapsulated by the sweet aromatics of pink musk and vanilla cloud. What are you waiting for? Start spritzing!

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels' Share Paradis Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An ode to expertly made spirits and their artisanal nature, Angels Share Paradis (30ml) is a concentrated extrait de parfum belonging to Kilian’s ‘The Liquors’ collection. Capturing the distinguished aroma of oak-matured liqueurs, this rich, savoury cologne grants a mesmeric scent trail. A medley of raspberry and cognac entices the senses to open, distilled in rose oil orpur for a luxuriously refined allure. As this heady redolence settles, notes of roasted praline and tonka bean absolut leave a smoky, caramel-like undertone that settles onto the skin with lingering warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Call for a Good Time 50ml
listings.description: A universe of sights and sounds, where reality and dreams collide beneath the biggest mirror ball in Asia, Discothèque's Call For a Good Time Eau de Parfum (50ml) transports you straight to Womb: the epicentre of Tokyo's club scene. With powdery violet, ylang-ylang, yuzu and earthy angelica over an electrifying heart of jasmine flowers, this euphoric aroma evokes the hypnotic allure of the lasers, the haze of the smoke machines, sparks of attraction and sparkling mirrors - anchored by a tantalising base of amber, musk and pepper. Perfect for pleasure-seekers, this transcendent blend is your passport to Tokyo; summoning the blinking screens, towering buildings and infectious energy Japan's multi-faceted capital. And let's not forget the scent's beautiful, cubic glass bottle and 'disco ball' lid, designed to reflect you as much as your signature scent does.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Serving as a sensorial ode to British landscapes, the Jo Malone London English Oak and Hazelnut Cologne (9ml) is a fragrance filled with notes inspired by nature's beauty. Opening with top notes of green hazelnut, deepened by cedarwood accents and further grounded by enticing, earthy notes of roasted oak, this forestry fusion settles on the skin with an airy freshness. Ideal for your springtime scent profile or lunch dates in summer, this subtly warm fragrance is sure to grant you compliments at every turn.

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Sweat, Tears, Paradise 50ml
listings.description: The kick of absinthe and the rhythm of waves, Discothèque's Sweat, Tears, Paradise Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a transcendent blend of samphire, sea salt, mimosa and musk that transports you to Greece and the day-to-night raptures of Cavo Paradiso. A place where you dance like a mortal but feel like a god, Cavo Paradiso - nestled in the cliffs of Mykonos - was built as a 'temple to music'; serving dance-evangelists since 1995, who flock to its idyllic island setting. Conjuring the heady-scented air, the salty breeze, the aniseed of absinthe and the musky tang of ambroxan, this fragrance invokes endless evenings and summers that stretch into warm, balmy autumns. It's the optimistic thrill of golden skin and sun-bleached hair; sunglasses, salt and a beat that erupts to a euphoric drop. And let's not forget the scent's beautiful, cubic glass bottle and 'disco ball' lid, designed to reflect you as much as your signature scent does.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance - Jo by Jo Loves 50ml
listings.description: Uniting notes of grapefruit, bitter orange, lime and spearmint, this Jo by Jo Loves scent was blended especially for the creator, Jo, herself. With a bewitching blend of refreshing grapefruit-infused citrus that softens down to a spiced, warming vetiver, cedarwood and black pepper base, ‘Jo by Jo Loves’ is a light, unique scent that suits both men and women. The fragrance is housed in a classic Jo Loves red bottle with a beautiful red and white gift box, making a perfect present – to yourself or a loved one – that will earn you limitless brownie points. It’s available in two sizes – 50ml and 100ml, so you can ensure you’re never without your signature scent – keep one in your bag, one on your desk and one in pride of place on your dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Sunkissed Goddess Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Bottling the spirit of summer, Kilian’s Sunkissed Goddess (7.5ml) is a limited-edition fragrance inspired by the timeless Tahitian scent of monoi oil. A new take on the traditional Polynesian elixir, this creamy infusion stars a delicate blend of ylang-ylang and tiare flower, evoking a soft, sun-soaked sensuality. A warm blend of coconut and vanilla cocoon the floral medley in velvety sweetness, before the brand's olfactive signature of guaiac wood and cistus labdanum anchor the aroma with a vibrant appeal. Rich yet airy, this perfume invites the senses to enjoy each day as though basking on the sun-kissed beaches of Tahiti.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian BACCARAT ROUGE 540 Extrait de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Maison Francis Kurkdijan's Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum (70ml) is a woody, ambery floral extrait amplifies the signature aura of the original, blending luminous jasmine and saffron with a hypnotic, mineral ambergris. The heart reveals hints of bitter almond, adding a subtle gourmand touch, while woody accords of cedar and musk deepen the sensuality. Crafted with mastery and time-honoured wisdom, it offers a long-lasting, enveloping scent trail that is both refined and hypnotic. Encased in a striking red bottle reminiscent of Baccarat's legendary crystal, this perfume is a true expression of luxury, an olfactory masterpiece that embodies elegance, warmth and poetic allure.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves Rose & Dates A Fragrance 50ml
listings.description: Experience romance in just a spritz with the Jo Loves Roses & Dates (50ml). Transporting the senses to sun-drenched city of Marrakesh, this aroma captures the warming sensuality of the 'Red City'. Rich and decadent, fresh dates tempt the senses with a sweetened nuance, blended with delicate rose petals for a softer touch. A spiced fusion of amber, jasmine and pink pepper imitate the scents experienced walking through Moroccan markets in the peak of the sun's rays.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Black Phantom Eau de Parfum 50ml Perfume Spray
listings.description: A spritz of this will whisk you away to a creaky pirate ship bobbing on black, turbulent seas and shrouded in mystery and adventure. The scent of Black Phantom Eau de Parfum offers a hidden treasure among the chaos, with its tagline, Memento Mori, serving as a stark reminder of death encouraging you to grab adventure by the hands with each day. A tad boozy, a tad chocolatey, this addictive fragrance is sure to make the wearer feel sexy, confident and alluring. French rum is joined by rich coffee, smooth vetiver essence, sweet sugar cane and creamy sandalwood, then slightly soured by notes of cyanide accord. Like pirate-infested waters, this perfume is sure to keep you feeling alive and on your toes.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Black Phantom Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: As intoxicating as its name suggests, Fracdacric Malles Carnal Flower blooms from delicate beginnings to a dark, seductive heart. Shy to begin with, this multi-faceted fragrance is an ode to awakening evolving from the bashful notes of water fruits (melon) and citrus leaves which lend a verdant freshness, to the heady thrum of tuberose that gives this scent its sensuous appeal. An emblem of forbidden pleasure, this tantalising flower has a depth and mystery that is forbidden to young women in some cultures believed to have the power to intoxicate the senses. With coconut to add a subtle lightness, and camphora to quieten the noise of these opulent blooms, the muse for the fragrance was Fracdacrics aunt (the famous French actress Candice Bergen), who played in the film Carnal Knowledge alongside Jack Nicholson. Voluptuous and decadent, this scent is ruby velvet, black satin and the thrill of an illicit tryst

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum 50ml
